name: Bulbasaur
description_en: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
description_es: Bulbasaur disfruta durmiendo al sol; la semilla de su espalda crece al absorber la luz solar.

name: Ivysaur
description_en: There is a bud on this Pokémon’s back. To support its weight, Ivysaur’s legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it starts spending more time lying in the sunlight, it’s a sign that the bud will bloom into a large flower soon.
description_es: El capullo de su espalda hace que Ivysaur desarrolle patas fuertes; pronto florecerá al sol.

name: Venusaur
description_en: There is a large flower on Venusaur’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
description_es: La gran flor de Venusaur adquiere colores vivos con sol y nutrientes; su aroma tranquiliza.

name: Charmander
description_en: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is enjoying itself. If the Pokémon becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
description_es: La llama de la cola de Charmander refleja sus emociones y arde con fuerza cuando se enfada.

name: Charmeleon
description_en: Charmeleon mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
description_es: Charmeleon ataca sin piedad con sus garras; ante rivales fuertes, su llama se vuelve azulada.

name: Charizard
description_en: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
description_es: Charizard surca los cielos buscando rivales poderosos; su aliento ardiente puede derretir cualquier cosa.

name: Squirtle
description_en: Squirtle’s shell is not merely used for protection. The shell’s rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this Pokémon to swim at high speeds.
description_es: El caparazón de Squirtle lo protege y reduce la resistencia del agua para nadar velozmente.

name: Wartortle
description_en: Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as Wartortle ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon’s toughness as a battler.
description_es: La cola peluda de Wartortle se oscurece con la edad; las marcas del caparazón revelan su dureza.

name: Blastoise
description_en: Blastoise has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
description_es: Los cañones del caparazón de Blastoise disparan chorros de agua con una puntería extraordinaria.

name: Caterpie
description_en: Its body is soft and weak. In nature, its perpetual fate is to be seen by others as food.
description_es: Caterpie tiene el cuerpo blando y débil, por lo que suele ser presa de otros Pokémon.

name: Metapod
description_en: Its hard shell doesn’t crack a bit even if Pikipek pecks at it, but it will tip over, spilling out its insides.
description_es: El resistente caparazón de Metapod soporta picotazos, aunque un golpe fuerte puede hacerlo volcar.

name: Butterfree
description_en: Nectar from pretty flowers is its favorite food. In fields of flowers, it has heated battles with Cutiefly for territory.
description_es: Butterfree se alimenta del néctar de las flores y disputa territorios floridos con Cutiefly.

name: Weedle
description_en: Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It is capable of distinguishing its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes just by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).
description_es: Weedle distingue las hojas que le gustan gracias al agudo olfato de su nariz roja.

name: Kakuna
description_en: Kakuna remains virtually immobile as it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it is extremely busy as it prepares for its coming evolution. This is evident from how hot the shell becomes to the touch.
description_es: Kakuna permanece inmóvil en los árboles mientras su interior se prepara intensamente para evolucionar.

name: Beedrill
description_en: Beedrill is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest—this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.
description_es: Beedrill defiende ferozmente su territorio; acercarse a su nido puede provocar ataques en enjambre.

name: Pidgey
description_en: Pidgey has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It is capable of unerringly returning home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
description_es: Pidgey tiene un sentido de la orientación excepcional y siempre encuentra el camino a su nido.

name: Pidgeotto
description_en: Pidgeotto claims a large area as its own territory. This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its living space. If its territory is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
description_es: Pidgeotto patrulla un territorio extenso y castiga a los intrusos con sus afiladas garras.

name: Pidgeot
description_en: This Pokémon has a dazzling plumage of beautifully glossy feathers. Many Trainers are captivated by the striking beauty of the feathers on its head, compelling them to choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.
description_es: El magnífico plumaje brillante de Pidgeot fascina a numerosos entrenadores Pokémon.

name: Rattata
description_en: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.
description_es: Rattata es frecuente, pero sus incisivos afilados pueden atravesar incluso la madera dura.

name: Raticate
description_en: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.
description_es: Los bigotes de Raticate mantienen su equilibrio; se enfada y muerde a quien los toca.

name: Spearow
description_en: Due to its short wings, it can’t fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.
description_es: Las alas cortas de Spearow limitan su vuelo; suele picotear Pokémon de tipo Bicho.

name: Fearow
description_en: In Alola, fish Pokémon are its prey. It can be seen circling above the ocean searching for food.
description_es: Fearow sobrevuela el océano de Alola buscando Pokémon pez para alimentarse.

name: Ekans
description_en: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.
description_es: Ekans se traga enteros los huevos de Pokémon pájaro, aunque a veces se le atascan.

name: Arbok
description_en: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.
description_es: Arbok intimida con el dibujo de su vientre y después inmoviliza a sus adversarios enrollándose.

name: Pikachu
description_en: While sleeping, it generates electricity in the sacs in its cheeks. If it’s not getting enough sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.
description_es: Pikachu almacena electricidad en las mejillas mientras duerme; descansar poco debilita sus descargas.

name: Raichu
description_en: Because so many Trainers like the way Pikachu looks, you don’t see this Pokémon very often.
description_es: Raichu se ve con menos frecuencia porque muchos entrenadores prefieren conservar a Pikachu.

name: Sandshrew
description_en: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.
description_es: Sandshrew seca su piel húmeda cerca de volcanes, aprovechando el calor geotérmico.

name: Sandslash
description_en: Thanks to its thick claws, it’s good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.
description_es: Sandslash trepa árboles con sus gruesas garras y a menudo duerme entre las ramas.

name: Nidoran♀
description_en: Nidoran♀ has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
description_es: Las púas venenosas de Nidoran hembra protegen su cuerpo pequeño; al enfadarse libera toxinas.

name: Nidorina
description_en: When Nidorina are with their friends or family, they keep their barbs tucked away to prevent hurting each other. This Pokémon appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
description_es: Nidorina retrae sus púas junto a familiares y amigos, y se inquieta si se separa.

name: Nidoqueen
description_en: Nidoqueen’s body is encased in extremely hard scales. It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles. This Pokémon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.
description_es: Las durísimas escamas de Nidoqueen la protegen; defiende a sus crías con una fuerza formidable.

name: Nidoran♂
description_en: Nidoran♂ has developed muscles for moving its ears. Thanks to them, the ears can be freely moved in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon’s notice.
description_es: Nidoran macho mueve las orejas en cualquier dirección y detecta incluso sonidos muy tenues.

name: Nidorino
description_en: Nidorino has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
description_es: El cuerno de Nidorino es durísimo; ante amenazas eriza sus púas y se lanza al ataque.

name: Nidoking
description_en: Nidoking’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this Pokémon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
description_es: La poderosa cola de Nidoking puede derribar torres metálicas; es imparable cuando se enfurece.

name: Clefairy
description_en: Bathed in moonlight, its wings glow faintly. Without even flapping, Clefairy rises into the air, where it dances around.
description_es: Bajo la luz de la luna, las alas de Clefairy brillan y este Pokémon danza en el aire.

name: Clefable
description_en: Some scientists believe that it gazes intently at the sky on nights with a full moon because it’s homesick.
description_es: Algunos científicos creen que Clefable contempla la luna llena porque siente nostalgia de su hogar.

name: Vulpix
description_en: It manipulates balls of fire to catch its prey. If you raise one from when it’s young, it will grow close to you like a puppy Pokémon.
description_es: Vulpix manipula bolas de fuego para cazar y puede encariñarse mucho con quien lo cría.

name: Ninetales
description_en: The flickering flames it spews from its mouth leave its opponents hypnotized. Then, this extremely intelligent Pokémon attacks.
description_es: Ninetales hipnotiza con las llamas de su boca y aprovecha su gran inteligencia para atacar.

name: Jigglypuff
description_en: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they’re shouting!
description_es: Las canciones de Jigglypuff varían entre regiones; algunas suenan más como gritos que como melodías.

name: Wigglytuff
description_en: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!
description_es: Cuando se enfada, Wigglytuff inhala aire y puede inflarse hasta veinte veces su tamaño.

name: Zubat
description_en: Their skin is so thin that they’ll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another’s bodies.
description_es: La piel delgada de Zubat se quema con el sol; los grupos se reúnen para darse calor.

name: Golbat
description_en: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.
description_es: Golbat puede beber tanta sangre de una vez que después es incapaz de volar.

name: Oddish
description_en: Oddish searches for fertile, nutrient-rich soil, then plants itself. During the daytime, while it is planted, this Pokémon’s feet are thought to change shape and become similar to the roots of trees.
description_es: Oddish busca suelos fértiles para enterrarse; de día sus pies parecen transformarse en raíces.

name: Gloom
description_en: From its mouth Gloom drips honey that smells absolutely horrible. Apparently, it loves the horrid stench. It sniffs the noxious fumes and then drools even more of its honey.
description_es: Gloom produce una miel de olor espantoso que parece encantarle y le provoca más salivación.

name: Vileplume
description_en: Vileplume has the world’s largest petals. They are used to attract prey that are then doused with toxic spores. Once the prey are immobilized, this Pokémon catches and devours them.
description_es: Los enormes pétalos de Vileplume atraen presas que luego inmoviliza con esporas tóxicas.

name: Paras
description_en: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.
description_es: Unos hongos parásitos controlan a Paras y dirigen gran parte de su comportamiento.

name: Parasect
description_en: Its poisonous spores are also used in traditional medicine. Apparently, spores produced in Alola are not of very good quality.
description_es: Las esporas venenosas de Parasect se usan en medicina tradicional, aunque las de Alola son peores.

name: Venonat
description_en: Venonat is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even minuscule prey.
description_es: Venonat tiene vello rígido que lo protege y ojos enormes capaces de detectar presas diminutas.

name: Venomoth
description_en: Venomoth is nocturnal—it is a Pokémon that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
description_es: Venomoth es nocturno y caza insectos atraídos por la luz de las farolas.

name: Diglett
description_en: Around their crops, farmers plant the kind of tree that Diglett like to eat as a way of getting Diglett to plow the fields for them.
description_es: Los agricultores aprovechan las costumbres alimentarias de Diglett para que remueva sus campos.

name: Dugtrio
description_en: Dugtrio’s heads are sleek and smooth and incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with its headbutts.
description_es: Las cabezas de Dugtrio son lisas y extremadamente duras, capaces de atravesar cualquier suelo.

name: Meowth
description_en: It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can make friends with Meowth easily. But it’s fickle, so you can’t count on that friendship lasting.
description_es: Meowth adora las monedas y es fácil ganarse su amistad con una, aunque cambia de humor.

name: Persian
description_en: This Pokémon is popular with rich people. It’s also targeted by hunters who are after the jewel in its forehead.
description_es: Persian es popular entre personas adineradas y perseguido por la joya de su frente.

name: Psyduck
description_en: It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.
description_es: El cerebro de Psyduck se vuelve mucho más activo cuando sufre dolor de cabeza.

name: Golduck
description_en: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.
description_es: Golduck es un nadador experto capaz de mantenerse en el agua durante dos días seguidos.

name: Mankey
description_en: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.
description_es: Cuando un Mankey se enfada, contagia su ira al resto del grupo y provoca alboroto.

name: Primeape
description_en: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.
description_es: Los resistentes vasos sanguíneos del cerebro de Primeape soportan sus continuos ataques de furia.

name: Growlithe
description_en: It has lived alongside humans since ages ago. Its bones have been found in excavations of ruins from the Stone Age.
description_es: Growlithe convive con los humanos desde la Edad de Piedra, como demuestran restos arqueológicos.

name: Arcanine
description_en: There are so many old tales about them that they’re called legendary Pokémon, but there are way more of them around than you’d expect.
description_es: Arcanine aparece en muchas leyendas antiguas, aunque es más común de lo que se cree.

name: Poliwag
description_en: The direction of the swirl on their stomachs differs depending on where they live. Poliwag aficionados can tell them apart at a glance.
description_es: El dibujo en espiral del vientre de Poliwag cambia según el lugar donde vive.

name: Poliwhirl
description_en: Its health suffers when its skin dries out, so be sure to moisturize it diligently.
description_es: La salud de Poliwhirl empeora si su piel se reseca; necesita mantenerse húmedo.

name: Poliwrath
description_en: The muscles it has developed through swimming are thick and powerful. When it lands a square punch, it can turn huge boulders to dust.
description_es: Los potentes músculos de Poliwrath, desarrollados al nadar, le permiten pulverizar rocas de un puñetazo.

name: Abra
description_en: It can read others’ minds and will teleport away when danger approaches. You must clear your mind if you want to catch it.
description_es: Abra lee la mente y se teletransporta al percibir peligro; capturarlo requiere concentración.

name: Kadabra
description_en: It possesses strong mental capabilities, but its psychic powers are halved when it’s not holding a silver spoon.
description_es: Kadabra tiene enormes poderes psíquicos, pero se reducen cuando pierde su cuchara plateada.

name: Alakazam
description_en: If it trusts someone deeply, it will let them have one of its spoons. Anything you eat with that spoon is apparently delicious.
description_es: Alakazam ofrece una de sus cucharas a quienes confía; se dice que hace deliciosa la comida.

name: Machop
description_en: It likes food that’s highly nutritious because its instincts drive it to build muscle efficiently.
description_es: Machop prefiere alimentos nutritivos porque su instinto lo impulsa a desarrollar músculos.

name: Machoke
description_en: A popular motif for sculptures, its incredibly well-developed muscles have captured the imagination of many an artist.
description_es: Los músculos impresionantes de Machoke lo han convertido en una inspiración para escultores.

name: Machamp
description_en: With four arms, it can attack and defend simultaneously. It’s said to have mastered every martial art in the world.
description_es: Con sus cuatro brazos, Machamp ataca y se defiende a la vez; domina todas las artes marciales.

name: Bellsprout
description_en: Bellsprout’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this Pokémon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
description_es: El cuerpo flexible de Bellsprout esquiva ataques y su boca escupe un líquido capaz de disolver hierro.

name: Weepinbell
description_en: Weepinbell has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the Pokémon hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
description_es: Weepinbell se cuelga de ramas con un gancho para dormir; a veces se cae mientras sueña.

name: Victreebel
description_en: Victreebel has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this Pokémon swallows it whole.
description_es: Victreebel mueve una liana para atraer a sus presas y después las engulle enteras.

name: Tentacool
description_en: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.
description_es: El cuerpo de Tentacool es casi todo agua; una pequeña parte contiene el órgano venenoso.

name: Tentacruel
description_en: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it’s a warning sign.
description_es: Tentacruel se comunica encendiendo los orbes rojos de su cabeza; sus destellos pueden advertir peligro.

name: Geodude
description_en: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.
description_es: Geodude trepa acantilados con ambas manos y ha inspirado a personas a practicar escalada.

name: Graveler
description_en: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.
description_es: Graveler desciende rodando por barrancos y puede explotar al caer en un río.

name: Golem
description_en: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.
description_es: Golem puede detonar su propio cuerpo y usar la explosión para ascender laderas abruptas.

name: Ponyta
description_en: Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This Pokémon becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
description_es: Ponyta nace muy débil y fortalece sus patas siguiendo a sus padres entre tropiezos.

name: Rapidash
description_en: Rapidash usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this Pokémon turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
description_es: Rapidash galopa tranquilamente por las praderas, pero al acelerar su crin ardiente se intensifica.

name: Slowpoke
description_en: Although their tails, which fall off naturally, can easily be found lying around, they’re a precious ingredient for cooking.
description_es: La cola que Slowpoke pierde de manera natural es un ingrediente muy apreciado para cocinar.

name: Slowbro
description_en: Shellder, in its greed to suck out more and more sweetness from Slowbro’s tail, has metamorphosed into a spiral-shaped shell.
description_es: El Shellder unido a la cola de Slowbro se transformó en una concha espiral.

name: Magnemite
description_en: Perhaps because electrical lines are often buried these days, the number of Magnemite attacks on power plants has increased.
description_es: Magnemite se acerca cada vez más a centrales eléctricas, quizá porque ahora se entierran los cables.

name: Magneton
description_en: When rain clouds form, many Magneton gather in high places to wait for lightning to strike.
description_es: Magneton suele reunirse en lugares elevados cuando se forman nubes de tormenta.

name: Farfetch'd
description_en: Farfetch’d is always seen with a stalk from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good stalks and bad stalks. This Pokémon has been known to fight with others over stalks.
description_es: Farfetch'd lleva siempre un tallo vegetal y puede pelear con otros para conseguir uno mejor.

name: Doduo
description_en: Doduo’s two heads contain completely identical brains. A scientific study reported that on rare occasions, there will be examples of this Pokémon possessing different sets of brains.
description_es: Las dos cabezas de Doduo suelen tener cerebros idénticos, aunque existen excepciones.

name: Dodrio
description_en: Apparently, the heads aren’t the only parts of the body that Dodrio has three of. It has three sets of hearts and lungs as well, so it is capable of running long distances without rest.
description_es: Dodrio tiene tres corazones y tres pares de pulmones, por lo que corre largas distancias.

name: Seel
description_en: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don’t bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.
description_es: La gruesa capa de grasa de Seel lo protege del frío, pero se fatiga en aguas cálidas.

name: Dewgong
description_en: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.
description_es: Dewgong toma el sol después de comer para elevar su temperatura corporal y facilitar la digestión.

name: Grimer
description_en: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They’re said to be on the verge of extinction.
description_es: Grimer tiene cada vez menos alimento debido a que las aguas residuales industriales son más limpias.

name: Muk
description_en: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they’ve long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.
description_es: La población de Muk ha disminuido porque las personas lo persiguen por propagar gérmenes.

name: Shellder
description_en: Even when its shell is closed, its tongue still hangs out. If you give its tongue a good yank, the shock will cause Shellder to open its shell.
description_es: Shellder mantiene la lengua fuera incluso con la concha cerrada; tirarla le hace abrirse.

name: Cloyster
description_en: Slowpoke tails are its favorite food. It has even been known to come up on land to look for Slowpoke from time to time.
description_es: Cloyster adora las colas de Slowpoke y a veces sale a tierra firme para buscarlas.

name: Gastly
description_en: Poisonous gas comprises 95% of its body. It’s said that the remaining 5% is made up of the souls of those who died from the gas.
description_es: El cuerpo de Gastly está formado principalmente por gas venenoso y, según dicen, por almas.

name: Haunter
description_en: It’s dangerous to go outside alone on nights when you’re feeling sad. Haunter will catch you, and you won’t be able to go back home.
description_es: Haunter acecha a quienes salen solos durante noches tristes y puede impedirles volver a casa.

name: Gengar
description_en: Even your home isn’t safe. Gengar will lurk in whatever dark corner of a room it can find and wait for its chance to catch its prey.
description_es: Gengar se oculta en rincones oscuros incluso dentro de las casas para sorprender a sus presas.

name: Onix
description_en: Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
description_es: Un imán cerebral orienta a Onix bajo tierra; su cuerpo se vuelve más liso con los años.

name: Drowzee
description_en: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn’t particularly like eating them.
description_es: Drowzee duerme a sus presas para comerse sus sueños, aunque no le gustan los malos.

name: Hypno
description_en: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can’t sleep at night in hospitals.
description_es: Algunos Hypno ayudan en hospitales a médicos que tratan pacientes con insomnio.

name: Krabby
description_en: Krabby live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these Pokémon can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
description_es: Krabby vive en madrigueras de playas arenosas y pelea por territorio donde escasea la comida.

name: Kingler
description_en: Kingler has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the Pokémon quickly tires.
description_es: Kingler usa su enorme pinza para comunicarse, pero su gran peso lo cansa enseguida.

name: Voltorb
description_en: Voltorb is extremely sensitive—it explodes at the slightest of shocks. It is rumored that it was first created when a Poké Ball was exposed to a powerful pulse of energy.
description_es: Voltorb es muy sensible y explota con pequeños golpes; se relaciona su origen con una Poké Ball.

name: Electrode
description_en: One of Electrode’s characteristics is its attraction to electricity. It is a problematical Pokémon that congregates mostly at electrical power plants to feed on electricity that has just been generated.
description_es: Electrode se concentra en centrales eléctricas para alimentarse de la electricidad generada.

name: Exeggcute
description_en: Although they are the same size as other Exeggcute, the ones produced in Alola are quite heavy. Their shells are packed full.
description_es: Los Exeggcute de Alola pueden pesar más de lo normal porque sus cáscaras están muy llenas.

name: Exeggutor
description_en: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.
description_es: Cada cabeza de Exeggutor piensa por separado; si discrepan sobre el rumbo, no puede moverse.

name: Cubone
description_en: It wears its mother’s skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it’s clear that it’s always crying.
description_es: Cubone lleva el cráneo de su madre; nadie conoce su rostro y siempre parece llorar.

name: Marowak
description_en: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.
description_es: Marowak se comunica golpeando huesos siguiendo numerosos patrones rítmicos distintos.

name: Hitmonlee
description_en: Hitmonlee’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
description_es: Hitmonlee estira y contrae las piernas para ejecutar patadas devastadoras; luego relaja sus músculos.

name: Hitmonchan
description_en: Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working toward a world championship. This Pokémon has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
description_es: Hitmonchan posee un espíritu de boxeador incansable y nunca se rinde ante la adversidad.

name: Lickitung
description_en: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it’s really clean is...questionable.
description_es: Lickitung limpia la suciedad con la lengua, aunque deja un olor desagradable en lo que lame.

name: Koffing
description_en: Koffing embodies toxic substances. It mixes the toxins with raw garbage to set off a chemical reaction that results in a terribly powerful poison gas. The higher the temperature, the more gas is concocted by this Pokémon.
description_es: Koffing combina basura y toxinas en su interior para producir un gas venenoso muy potente.

name: Weezing
description_en: Weezing alternately shrinks and inflates its twin bodies to mix together toxic gases inside. The more the gases are mixed, the more powerful the toxins become. The Pokémon also becomes more putrid.
description_es: Weezing mezcla gases tóxicos inflando y desinflando sus dos cuerpos; así aumenta su toxicidad.

name: Rhyhorn
description_en: Rhyhorn’s brain is very small. It is so dense, while on a run it forgets why it started running in the first place. It apparently remembers sometimes if it demolishes something.
description_es: Rhyhorn tiene un cerebro pequeño y a veces olvida por qué empezó a correr.

name: Rhydon
description_en: Rhydon has a horn that serves as a drill. It is used for destroying rocks and boulders. This Pokémon occasionally rams into streams of magma, but the armor-like hide prevents it from feeling the heat.
description_es: El cuerno de Rhydon perfora rocas y su piel acorazada soporta el calor del magma.

name: Chansey
description_en: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.
description_es: Chansey es poco común porque sus huevos fueron recolectados excesivamente por personas.

name: Tangela
description_en: Tangela’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
description_es: Las lianas de Tangela se desprenden sin dolor y vuelven a crecer al día siguiente.

name: Kangaskhan
description_en: You shouldn’t get close to the child when it’s playing outside its mother’s pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.
description_es: Kangaskhan vigila de cerca a su cría y puede reaccionar si alguien se acerca demasiado.

name: Horsea
description_en: If Horsea senses danger, it will reflexively spray a dense black ink from its mouth and try to escape. This Pokémon swims by cleverly flapping the fin on its back.
description_es: Horsea expulsa tinta negra al sentir peligro y nada agitando la aleta de su espalda.

name: Seadra
description_en: Seadra generates whirlpools by spinning its body. The whirlpools are strong enough to swallow even fishing boats. This Pokémon weakens prey with these currents, then swallows it whole.
description_es: Seadra crea remolinos girando sobre sí mismo, debilita a sus presas y las engulle.

name: Goldeen
description_en: The way it swims along fluttering its dress-like fins has earned it the name “princess of the water.”
description_es: Goldeen nada con aletas parecidas a un vestido, por lo que le llaman princesa del agua.

name: Seaking
description_en: To attract females, males dance on the river’s floor. The females gather around the male that dances most gracefully.
description_es: Los machos de Seaking bailan en el fondo del río para atraer a las hembras.

name: Staryu
description_en: No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!
description_es: Staryu tiene una capacidad regenerativa extraordinaria y puede recuperarse de heridas en medio día.

name: Starmie
description_en: It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.
description_es: Starmie gira su cuerpo geométrico para nadar y parece emitir misteriosas ondas de radio.

name: Mr. Mime
description_en: It creates invisible walls with its pantomiming. If you don’t act impressed, it will attack you with a double slap!
description_es: Mr. Mime crea paredes invisibles con mímica y se enfada si nadie admira su actuación.

name: Scyther
description_en: Some call it a ninja. Its movements— imperceptibly quick—are sufficient to cleave the air in two. It’s very popular in Alola.
description_es: Scyther se mueve con una rapidez casi imperceptible; sus cuchillas parecen cortar el aire.

name: Jynx
description_en: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.
description_es: Los extraños sonidos de Jynx se parecen al habla humana e inspiran canciones musicales.

name: Electabuzz
description_en: While it’s often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.
description_es: A Electabuzz se le culpa de apagones que, con frecuencia, se deben a errores humanos.

name: Magmar
description_en: The hotter the place, the better they feel. Magmar in Alola are said to be hardier than those in other areas.
description_es: Magmar disfruta del calor intenso; los ejemplares de Alola son especialmente resistentes.

name: Pinsir
description_en: Although it’s tough, it can’t handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.
description_es: Pinsir es fuerte, pero soporta mal el frío y duerme escondido entre hojas.

name: Tauros
description_en: The climate seems to be related to the reason Tauros in Alola are a little calmer than those in other regions.
description_es: El clima de Alola parece volver a Tauros algo más tranquilo que en otras regiones.

name: Magikarp
description_en: Thanks to their strong hold on life, dirty water doesn’t bother them at all. They live in waters all over the world!
description_es: Magikarp resiste aguas contaminadas y habita entornos acuáticos de todo el mundo.

name: Gyarados
description_en: The energy from evolution stimulated its brain cells strongly, causing it to become very ferocious.
description_es: La energía de su evolución volvió a Gyarados extremadamente feroz y agresivo.

name: Lapras
description_en: They’ve been so cherished that there’s now an overabundance. The fish Pokémon population has declined in waters with too many Lapras.
description_es: La abundancia actual de Lapras ha reducido los peces en algunas zonas donde vive.

name: Ditto
description_en: It transforms into whatever it sees. If the thing it’s transforming into isn’t right in front of it, Ditto relies on its memory—so sometimes it fails.
description_es: Ditto copia lo que ve, pero cuando transforma algo de memoria puede equivocarse.

name: Eevee
description_en: Its genes are easily influenced by its surroundings. Even its face starts to look like that of its Trainer.
description_es: Los genes de Eevee cambian fácilmente según el ambiente, incluso su rostro puede parecerse al entrenador.

name: Vaporeon
description_en: It detects nearby moisture with its fin. When its fin begins trembling rapidly, that means rain will fall in a few hours.
description_es: Vaporeon percibe la humedad con su aleta y puede anticipar la llegada de la lluvia.

name: Jolteon
description_en: Its fur stands on end, becoming like needles it fires at enemies. Once they’re weakened, it finishes them off with a 10,000 volt shock.
description_es: El pelaje de Jolteon se eriza como agujas que lanza contra sus enemigos y descarga electricidad.

name: Flareon
description_en: The flame chamber inside its body ignites when Flareon gets agitated, reaching temperatures of up to 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es: Flareon posee una cámara de fuego interna que alcanza temperaturas extremas cuando se altera.

name: Porygon
description_en: It was built 20 years ago by scientists who dreamed of exploring space. Their dreams have yet to come true.
description_es: Porygon fue creado por científicos para explorar el espacio, aunque aún no cumple ese sueño.

name: Omanyte
description_en: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Those Helix Fossils are excavated from areas that were once oceans long, long ago.
description_es: Omanyte fue revivido de un fósil hélice encontrado en zonas que antaño eran océanos.

name: Omastar
description_en: It wraps its prey in its tentacles to immobilize them and then finishes them off with its sharp fangs.
description_es: Omastar inmoviliza a sus presas con tentáculos y las remata con colmillos afilados.

name: Kabuto
description_en: This Pokémon became extinct everywhere, except in a few areas. It protects itself with its hard shell.
description_es: Kabuto es un Pokémon prehistórico que sobrevivió en pocos lugares y se protege con su caparazón.

name: Kabutops
description_en: It swims at speeds of roughly 29 knots, quickly closing in on its prey and slashing into them with its scythes to finish them off.
description_es: Kabutops nada muy deprisa y caza cortando a sus presas con sus afiladas guadañas.

name: Aerodactyl
description_en: It flew through the open skies over the ancient continent as if they were its own. When it touched ground, its walk was weak and slow.
description_es: Aerodactyl dominaba los cielos prehistóricos, aunque caminaba torpemente por tierra.

name: Snorlax
description_en: It has no interest in anything other than eating. Even if you climb up on its stomach while it’s napping, it doesn’t seem to mind at all!
description_es: Snorlax solo piensa en comer y ni siquiera se molesta cuando alguien trepa sobre su barriga.

name: Articuno
description_en: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.
description_es: Articuno es un ave legendaria que controla el hielo y puede provocar nevadas al volar.

name: Zapdos
description_en: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. The Pokémon gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
description_es: Zapdos es un ave legendaria que domina la electricidad y gana energía con los rayos.

name: Moltres
description_en: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokémon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
description_es: Moltres es un ave legendaria de fuego que cura sus heridas sumergiéndose en magma.

name: Dratini
description_en: It sheds its skin—almost on a daily basis—and grows larger. Its skin is soft just after it’s been shed.
description_es: Dratini muda de piel casi a diario para seguir creciendo; tras mudar, queda muy blando.

name: Dragonair
description_en: Some say that if you see it at the start of the year, flying through the sky and twisting its body, you’ll be healthy all year long.
description_es: Se dice que ver a Dragonair volar al comenzar el año trae buena salud.

name: Dragonite
description_en: You’ll often hear tales of this kindhearted Pokémon rescuing people or Pokémon that are drowning.
description_es: Dragonite es un Pokémon bondadoso que rescata personas y Pokémon en peligro de ahogarse.

name: Mewtwo
description_en: Mewtwo is a Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans created this Pokémon’s body, they failed to endow Mewtwo with a compassionate heart.
description_es: Mewtwo fue creado mediante ingeniería genética, pero sus creadores no lograron darle compasión.

name: Mew
description_en: Mew is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.
description_es: Mew contiene supuestamente los genes de todos los Pokémon y puede hacerse invisible a voluntad.

name: Chikorita
description_en: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
description_es: Chikorita agita su hoja durante las batallas y desprende un aroma dulce que tranquiliza a sus rivales.

name: Bayleef
description_en: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
description_es: Las hojas enrolladas del cuello de Bayleef contienen brotes cuyo aroma anima a las personas.

name: Meganium
description_en: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.
description_es: La fragancia de la flor de Meganium calma emociones y reduce el espíritu de lucha adversario.

name: Cyndaquil
description_en: Cyndaquil protects itself by flaring up the flames on its back. The flames are vigorous if the Pokémon is angry. However, if it is tired, the flames splutter fitfully with incomplete combustion.
description_es: Cyndaquil se protege con llamas en su espalda; arden más si se enfada y vacilan si está cansado.

name: Quilava
description_en: Quilava keeps its foes at bay with the intensity of its flames and gusts of superheated air. This Pokémon applies its outstanding nimbleness to dodge attacks even while scorching the foe with flames.
description_es: Quilava esquiva con gran agilidad mientras rodea a sus rivales de fuego y aire sobrecalentado.

name: Typhlosion
description_en: Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokémon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.
description_es: Typhlosion se oculta tras ondas de calor y produce explosiones abrasadoras que reducen todo a cenizas.

name: Totodile
description_en: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
description_es: Aunque Totodile es pequeño, sus mandíbulas son tan fuertes que un mordisco juguetón puede herir.

name: Croconaw
description_en: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
description_es: Croconaw no suelta a sus presas al morderlas; sus colmillos curvados se enganchan firmemente.

name: Feraligatr
description_en: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
description_es: Feraligatr intimida con su boca enorme y carga con increíble velocidad gracias a sus fuertes patas.

name: Sentret
description_en: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
description_es: Los Sentret se turnan para vigilar mientras duermen; uno aislado siente demasiado miedo para descansar.

name: Furret
description_en: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
description_es: Furret es esbelto, rápido y capaz de escabullirse por espacios estrechos para huir del peligro.

name: Hoothoot
description_en: It cries out at the same time every day. A long time ago, people cherished it and considered it a divine messenger sent to tell the time.
description_es: Hoothoot canta cada día a la misma hora y antiguamente se consideraba un mensajero divino del tiempo.

name: Noctowl
description_en: When it turns its head entirely upside down, you know it’s troubled by something. If you don’t leave it be, it will peck you.
description_es: Cuando Noctowl gira la cabeza completamente, está preocupado; molestarlo puede hacer que picotee.

name: Ledyba
description_en: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.
description_es: Los tímidos Ledyba se agrupan y utilizan Reflejo para proteger su nido.

name: Ledian
description_en: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.
description_es: Ledian vuela de noche esparciendo polvo brillante que, según dicen, trae buena suerte.

name: Spinarak
description_en: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
description_es: El veneno de Spinarak no es muy fuerte, pero debilita a las presas atrapadas en su telaraña.

name: Ariados
description_en: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.
description_es: Ariados atrapa presas con hilos que escupe por la boca y sale a cazar activamente de noche.

name: Crobat
description_en: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.
description_es: Crobat se alimenta de sangre; si pasa mucho tiempo sin beberla, se debilita y no puede volar.

name: Chinchou
description_en: Chinchou blink their shining antennae at one another to claim their respective turf.
description_es: Chinchou se comunica parpadeando con sus antenas luminosas y así delimita su territorio.

name: Lanturn
description_en: It lives far down in the depths of the ocean. It blinds its prey with light, using the moment they’re dazzled to swallow them whole.
description_es: Lanturn vive en las profundidades marinas y deslumbra a sus presas antes de tragárselas.

name: Pichu
description_en: It has electric sacs in its cheeks. When they’re fully charged, Pichu plays very energetically.
description_es: Pichu guarda electricidad en sus mejillas y juega con gran energía cuando están cargadas.

name: Cleffa
description_en: Said to have ridden here on a shooting star, Cleffa seem to appear in places where meteorites have struck in the past.
description_es: Se dice que Cleffa llegó en estrellas fugaces y aparece cerca de antiguos meteoritos.

name: Igglybuff
description_en: Left to its own devices, it will constantly practice singing. You should make it take a break so it doesn’t hurt its throat.
description_es: Igglybuff practica canto continuamente; necesita descansar para no lastimarse la garganta.

name: Togepi
description_en: As its energy, Togepi uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
description_es: Togepi acumula sentimientos felices en su cascarón y después comparte esa alegría con otros.

name: Togetic
description_en: Togetic is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
description_es: Togetic trae buena fortuna y comparte su felicidad con quienes tienen un corazón puro.

name: Natu
description_en: The look in its eyes gives the impression that it’s carefully observing you. If you approach it, Natu will hop away.
description_es: Natu observa atentamente con sus ojos y se aleja saltando cuando alguien se aproxima.

name: Xatu
description_en: While it can see the future, it has no desire to change it, which is probably why it remains motionless at all times.
description_es: Xatu puede contemplar el futuro, pero no desea cambiarlo y permanece inmóvil.

name: Mareep
description_en: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.
description_es: La lana de Mareep genera electricidad por rozamiento; acariciarlo sin protección provoca descargas.

name: Flaaffy
description_en: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
description_es: Flaaffy acumula electricidad en su pelaje esponjoso y pierde lana si almacena demasiada.

name: Ampharos
description_en: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.
description_es: La cola brillante de Ampharos sirve como faro y es muy apreciada por los marineros.

name: Bellossom
description_en: A Bellossom grows flowers more beautifully if it has evolved from a smelly Gloom—the more stinky the better. At night, this Pokémon closes its petals and goes to sleep.
description_es: Las flores de Bellossom crecen mejor tras evolucionar de un Gloom maloliente; duerme cerrando los pétalos.

name: Marill
description_en: When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, Marill wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This Pokémon’s tail is flexible and configured to stretch.
description_es: Marill se sujeta a los árboles con su cola elástica cuando busca comida en ríos rápidos.

name: Azumarill
description_en: Azumarill can make balloons out of air. It makes these air balloons if it spots a drowning Pokémon. The air balloons enable the Pokémon in trouble to breathe.
description_es: Azumarill fabrica burbujas de aire para ayudar a Pokémon que se están ahogando.

name: Sudowoodo
description_en: The result of its holding the same pose all the time is arms that have become supple yet strong.
description_es: Por permanecer siempre en la misma postura, Sudowoodo desarrolló brazos flexibles y resistentes.

name: Politoed
description_en: The longer and more luxurious the curled hair on its head, the greater the number of Poliwag and Poliwhirl that will obey it.
description_es: Cuanto más largo es el rizo de Politoed, más Poliwag y Poliwhirl le obedecen.

name: Hoppip
description_en: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
description_es: Hoppip flota con el viento y une sus hojas a otros Hoppip para resistir ráfagas fuertes.

name: Skiploom
description_en: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
description_es: La flor de Skiploom se abre con el calor; por eso a veces se usa como termómetro.

name: Jumpluff
description_en: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
description_es: Jumpluff cruza mares montado en vientos cálidos y desciende al encontrar corrientes frías.

name: Aipom
description_en: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.
description_es: Aipom busca alimento entre las copas de los árboles y se abalanza emocionado sobre Bounsweet.

name: Sunkern
description_en: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
description_es: Sunkern se mueve muy poco para reservar nutrientes para evolucionar; vive del rocío matutino.

name: Sunflora
description_en: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
description_es: Sunflora transforma la luz solar en alimento y permanece activo durante los días cálidos.

name: Yanma
description_en: Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
description_es: Yanma ve a su alrededor sin mover los ojos y cambia de dirección bruscamente mientras vuela.

name: Wooper
description_en: Wooper usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.
description_es: Wooper vive principalmente en el agua; en tierra se recubre de una película tóxica y viscosa.

name: Quagsire
description_en: Quagsire hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.
description_es: Quagsire espera con la boca abierta bajo el agua hasta que alguna presa entra por accidente.

name: Espeon
description_en: Psychic power builds up in the orb on its forehead as it bathes in the sunshine. Espeon is not good at battling at night.
description_es: Espeon acumula energía psíquica en el orbe de su frente gracias a la luz solar.

name: Umbreon
description_en: It lurks in the dark of night looking for prey. At the moment it pounces, the rings on its body glow dimly but ominously.
description_es: Umbreon acecha a sus presas de noche y sus anillos brillan de forma tenue al atacar.

name: Murkrow
description_en: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow’s presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.
description_es: Murkrow recoge objetos brillantes para su jefe y es considerado por muchos un símbolo de mala suerte.

name: Slowking
description_en: It’s called “the sage of the sea.” It engages in battles of wits with Oranguru, but the result is usually a draw.
description_es: Slowking es conocido como el sabio del mar y mantiene duelos de inteligencia con Oranguru.

name: Misdreavus
description_en: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn’t deal well with folks who aren’t easily frightened.
description_es: Misdreavus imita llantos para asustar y se desconcierta ante personas que no sienten miedo.

name: Unown
description_en: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
description_es: Unown tiene forma de escritura antigua; nadie sabe si aparecieron antes las letras o estos Pokémon.

name: Wobbuffet
description_en: Wobbuffet does nothing but endure attacks—it won’t attack on its own. However, it won’t endure an attack on its tail. When that happens, the Pokémon will try to take the foe with it using Destiny Bond.
description_es: Wobbuffet resiste los ataques sin iniciar peleas, salvo que alguien golpee su cola.

name: Girafarig
description_en: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.
description_es: La cabeza trasera de Girafarig tiene un cerebro pequeño que permanece alerta día y noche.

name: Pineco
description_en: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.
description_es: Pineco pega cortezas a su cuerpo con saliva para hacerse más grueso; los ejemplares viejos son enormes.

name: Forretress
description_en: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.
description_es: Forretress traga presas dentro de su caparazón, pero nadie ha visto cómo es su interior.

name: Dunsparce
description_en: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.
description_es: Dunsparce huye cavando con la cola y encontrar uno se considera una suerte.

name: Gligar
description_en: Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
description_es: Gligar planea silenciosamente, se aferra a sus víctimas con las pinzas y les inyecta veneno.

name: Steelix
description_en: Steelix lives even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth’s core. There are records of this Pokémon reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
description_es: Steelix cava a profundidades mayores que Onix, acercándose incluso al núcleo de la Tierra.

name: Snubbull
description_en: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.
description_es: Snubbull parece agresivo, pero es tímido y otros Pokémon perrunos pueden intimidarlo.

name: Granbull
description_en: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.
description_es: Granbull es sensible y asustadizo, por lo que no resulta buen perro guardián.

name: Qwilfish
description_en: Qwilfish sucks in water, inflating itself. This Pokémon uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.
description_es: Qwilfish se hincha de agua y dispara púas venenosas mediante la presión de su cuerpo.

name: Scizor
description_en: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there’s nothing left but scraps.
description_es: Scizor golpea a sus enemigos sin descanso con pinzas duras como el acero.

name: Shuckle
description_en: Shuckle quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
description_es: Shuckle guarda bayas dentro del caparazón; mezcladas con sus fluidos, se convierten en zumo.

name: Heracross
description_en: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it’s not that good at flying.
description_es: Heracross recorre bosques buscando néctar dulce; es muy fuerte, pero no vuela especialmente bien.

name: Sneasel
description_en: It blends into the dark of night to ambush its prey. Sneasel will attack Sandshrew, but its hard skin can cause Sneasel’s claws to snap off.
description_es: Sneasel acecha en la oscuridad, aunque puede romper sus garras contra la piel dura de Sandshrew.

name: Teddiursa
description_en: This Pokémon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. Teddiursa concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.
description_es: Teddiursa produce una miel especial mezclando frutas con polen y le encanta lamer sus patas.

name: Ursaring
description_en: In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokémon walks through its forest gathering food every day.
description_es: Ursaring recorre diariamente los bosques donde habita para recolectar comida entre arroyos y árboles.

name: Slugma
description_en: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.
description_es: Slugma no tiene sangre: el magma caliente circula por su cuerpo y transporta nutrientes.

name: Magcargo
description_en: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.
description_es: El cuerpo de Magcargo está tan caliente que el agua se convierte en vapor al tocarlo.

name: Swinub
description_en: Swinub roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This Pokémon occasionally roots out hot springs.
description_es: Swinub remueve el suelo con el hocico buscando setas y, a veces, descubre aguas termales.

name: Piloswine
description_en: Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair that enables it to endure the freezing cold. This Pokémon uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
description_es: El pelaje largo de Piloswine lo protege del frío; sus colmillos desentierran comida bajo el hielo.

name: Corsola
description_en: In Alola, where their natural enemies Mareanie are plentiful, many Corsola have stubby branches on their heads.
description_es: Los Corsola de Alola suelen tener ramas cortas debido a la abundancia de sus depredadores.

name: Remoraid
description_en: Also known as the “sniper of the seas,” its water gun can hit prey without fail from over 300 feet away.
description_es: Remoraid es conocido como francotirador del mar porque dispara agua con una puntería extraordinaria.

name: Octillery
description_en: It usually sleeps in caves. The pitch-black ink that Octillery spits is also used for cooking.
description_es: Octillery duerme en cuevas y la tinta oscura que escupe también se utiliza para cocinar.

name: Delibird
description_en: It wraps food in its tail to carry it around. The Delibird with the biggest tail is the boss of the flock!
description_es: Delibird guarda comida en su cola; el que tiene la cola más grande dirige el grupo.

name: Mantine
description_en: Many people have taken up surfing because they admire how magnificently Mantine swims.
description_es: Mantine nada de manera tan espectacular que inspira a muchas personas a practicar surf.

name: Skarmory
description_en: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!
description_es: La armadura de acero de Skarmory parece pesada, pero puede volar a velocidades extraordinarias.

name: Houndour
description_en: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.
description_es: Houndour aúlla inquietantemente antes del amanecer para llamar a los integrantes de su manada.

name: Houndoom
description_en: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.
description_es: Antiguamente se temía a Houndoom por sus aullidos, que se asociaban con la muerte.

name: Kingdra
description_en: Kingdra sleeps on the seafloor where it is otherwise devoid of life. When a storm arrives, the Pokémon is said to awaken and wander about in search of prey.
description_es: Kingdra duerme en fondos marinos desiertos y despierta durante tormentas para buscar presas.

name: Phanpy
description_en: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.
description_es: Phanpy usa su larga trompa para rociarse con agua y jugar con otros de su especie.

name: Donphan
description_en: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.
description_es: Donphan posee una fuerza enorme y ayuda a despejar desprendimientos de rocas y lodo.

name: Porygon2
description_en: Even though it doesn’t die in the vacuum of space, it can’t move around very well in zero gravity.
description_es: Porygon2 sobrevive al vacío espacial, aunque apenas puede desplazarse en gravedad cero.

name: Stantler
description_en: Stantler’s magnificent antlers were traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction by those who were after the priceless antlers.
description_es: Stantler fue cazado casi hasta la extinción porque sus magníficas astas se vendían como arte.

name: Smeargle
description_en: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
description_es: Smeargle pinta símbolos con el líquido de su cola; algunos admiradores pagan mucho por sus dibujos.

name: Tyrogue
description_en: Tyrogue becomes stressed out if it does not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the Trainer must establish and uphold various training methods.
description_es: Tyrogue necesita entrenar todos los días y se estresa si no puede hacerlo.

name: Hitmontop
description_en: Hitmontop spins on its head at high speed, all the while delivering kicks. This technique is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense at the same time. The Pokémon travels faster spinning than it does walking.
description_es: Hitmontop gira sobre su cabeza mientras lanza patadas y se desplaza más rápido girando que caminando.

name: Smoochum
description_en: Highly perceptive sensors, Smoochum’s lips are kept moist by its daily application of tree sap.
description_es: Smoochum tiene labios muy sensibles y los mantiene húmedos aplicándoles savia de árbol.

name: Elekid
description_en: When its horns shine a bluish white, that’s the sign it’s fully charged. You’ll get a shocking jolt if you touch it!
description_es: Los cuernos de Elekid brillan de color blanco azulado cuando está totalmente cargado de electricidad.

name: Magby
description_en: Its body temperature is always around 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. If Magby falls into a small- enough pond, the whole thing will dry up.
description_es: El cuerpo de Magby está siempre a una temperatura muy alta y podría secar un pequeño estanque.

name: Miltank
description_en: Its milk is delicious and chock-full of nutrients. However, if you drink too much, it could make your stomach hurt, so be careful.
description_es: Miltank produce leche nutritiva y deliciosa, aunque beber demasiada puede causar dolor de estómago.

name: Blissey
description_en: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.
description_es: Blissey rebosa afecto; solo Chansey muy unidos a sus entrenadores pueden evolucionar en él.

name: Raikou
description_en: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.
description_es: Raikou representa la velocidad del rayo y sus rugidos sacuden el aire como una tormenta.

name: Entei
description_en: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
description_es: Entei encarna la pasión del magma y desata llamaradas capaces de consumir todo a su paso.

name: Suicune
description_en: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.
description_es: Suicune personifica la pureza del agua y tiene el poder de limpiar aguas contaminadas.

name: Larvitar
description_en: Raised on nutrients it finds in the dirt, it eats roughly a mountain’s worth of dirt before it becomes a pupa.
description_es: Larvitar se nutre de tierra y debe consumir enormes cantidades antes de transformarse en pupa.

name: Pupitar
description_en: This dangerous pupa thrashes about. Its shell is as hard as bedrock, containing its gradually forming new body within.
description_es: Pupitar se agita violentamente dentro de una coraza durísima mientras forma su nuevo cuerpo.

name: Tyranitar
description_en: This Pokémon is a mobile disaster, leaving mountains crumbled and houses destroyed in its wake.
description_es: Tyranitar es un desastre andante capaz de derrumbar montañas y destruir viviendas.

name: Lugia
description_en: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
description_es: Un simple movimiento de las alas de Lugia puede destrozar casas; vive oculto bajo el mar.

name: Ho-Oh
description_en: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
description_es: Las plumas de Ho-Oh brillan con siete colores y, según la leyenda, traen felicidad.

name: Celebi
description_en: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
description_es: Celebi viaja a través del tiempo y se asocia con la promesa de un futuro brillante.

name: Treecko
description_en: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.
description_es: Treecko conserva la calma incluso frente a rivales enormes y salta con habilidad entre las ramas.

name: Grovyle
description_en: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.
description_es: Grovyle salta entre las ramas tan velozmente que pocos Pokémon logran alcanzarlo en un bosque.

name: Sceptile
description_en: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.
description_es: Las semillas de la espalda de Sceptile contienen nutrientes que ayudan a revitalizar los árboles.

name: Torchic
description_en: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.
description_es: Torchic guarda fuego en su interior y su plumón suave transmite calor al abrazarlo.

name: Combusken
description_en: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.
description_es: Combusken combina llamas ardientes con potentes patadas y emite gritos fuertes durante las batallas.

name: Blaziken
description_en: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.
description_es: Las piernas de Blaziken le permiten saltar edificios altos y lanzar puñetazos envueltos en fuego.

name: Mudkip
description_en: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.
description_es: Mudkip respira por branquias en las mejillas y posee fuerza suficiente para romper grandes rocas.

name: Marshtomp
description_en: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.
description_es: Marshtomp se desplaza más rápido sobre barro que nadando gracias a sus fuertes patas traseras.

name: Swampert
description_en: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.
description_es: Swampert detecta tormentas por el sonido de las olas y apila rocas para protegerse.

name: Poochyena
description_en: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.
description_es: Poochyena come casi cualquier cosa y eriza la cola para intimidar a sus rivales.

name: Mightyena
description_en: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.
description_es: Mightyena vive en manadas y solo obedece a entrenadores que reconoce como superiores.

name: Zigzagoon
description_en: The hair on Zigzagoon’s back is bristly. It rubs the hard back hair against trees to leave its territorial markings. This Pokémon may play dead to fool foes in battle.
description_es: Zigzagoon marca los árboles con el pelo rígido de su espalda y a veces finge estar muerto.

name: Linoone
description_en: When hunting, Linoone will make a beeline straight for the prey at a full run. While this Pokémon is capable of topping 60 mph, it has to come to a screeching halt before it can turn.
description_es: Linoone corre en línea recta a gran velocidad, pero debe detenerse por completo para girar.

name: Wurmple
description_en: Wurmple is targeted by Swellow as prey. This Pokémon will try to resist by pointing the spikes on its rear at the attacking predator. It will weaken the foe by leaking poison from the spikes.
description_es: Wurmple se defiende de sus depredadores con púas traseras que liberan veneno.

name: Silcoon
description_en: Silcoon was thought to endure hunger and not consume anything before its evolution. However, it is now thought that this Pokémon slakes its thirst by drinking rainwater that collects on its silk.
description_es: Silcoon soporta el hambre mientras evoluciona y aprovecha el agua de lluvia acumulada en su seda.

name: Beautifly
description_en: Beautifly has a long mouth like a coiled needle, which is very convenient for collecting pollen from flowers. This Pokémon rides the spring winds as it flits around gathering pollen.
description_es: Beautifly recoge polen con su boca enrollada y vuela entre flores impulsado por brisas primaverales.

name: Cascoon
description_en: If it is attacked, Cascoon remains motionless however badly it may be hurt. It does so because if it were to move, its body would be weak upon evolution. This Pokémon will also not forget the pain it endured.
description_es: Cascoon permanece inmóvil ante los ataques y recuerda el dolor sufrido durante su evolución.

name: Dustox
description_en: When Dustox flaps its wings, a fine dust is scattered all over. This dust is actually a powerful poison that will even make a pro wrestler sick. This Pokémon searches for food using its antennae like radar.
description_es: Dustox esparce un polvo muy venenoso al batir las alas y busca comida con sus antenas.

name: Lotad
description_en: Lotad is said to have dwelled on land before. However, this Pokémon is thought to have returned to water because the leaf on its head grew large and heavy. It now lives by floating atop the water.
description_es: Lotad vive flotando sobre el agua gracias a la gran hoja que crece sobre su cabeza.

name: Lombre
description_en: Lombre’s entire body is covered by a slippery, slimy film. It feels horribly unpleasant to be touched by this Pokémon’s hands. Lombre is often mistaken for a human child.
description_es: Lombre está cubierto de una película viscosa y a veces se confunde con un niño humano.

name: Ludicolo
description_en: Upon hearing an upbeat and cheerful rhythm, the cells in Ludicolo’s body become very energetic and active. Even in battle, this Pokémon will exhibit an amazing amount of power.
description_es: Ludicolo gana energía y fuerza al escuchar ritmos alegres, incluso durante las batallas.

name: Seedot
description_en: Seedot looks exactly like an acorn when it is dangling from a tree branch. It startles other Pokémon by suddenly moving. This Pokémon polishes its body once a day using leaves.
description_es: Seedot parece una bellota colgando de una rama y pule su cuerpo diariamente con hojas.

name: Nuzleaf
description_en: This Pokémon pulls out the leaf on its head and makes a flute with it. The sound of Nuzleaf’s flute strikes fear and uncertainty in the hearts of people lost in a forest.
description_es: Nuzleaf convierte la hoja de su cabeza en una flauta cuyo sonido inquieta a los viajeros.

name: Shiftry
description_en: Shiftry’s large fans generate awesome gusts of wind at a speed close to 100 feet per second. The whipped-up wind blows anything away. This Pokémon chooses to live quietly deep in forests.
description_es: Shiftry genera fuertes ráfagas con sus enormes abanicos y vive oculto en bosques profundos.

name: Taillow
description_en: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.
description_es: Taillow acaba de dejar el nido, llora de soledad por las noches y se alimenta de Wurmple.

name: Swellow
description_en: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.
description_es: Swellow cuida mucho sus brillantes alas y suele limpiar las de otros individuos de su especie.

name: Wingull
description_en: It builds nests in cliffs by the sea. It circles the skies above the ocean looking for its favorite food—Wishiwashi.
description_es: Wingull anida en acantilados costeros y vuela sobre el mar en busca de peces.

name: Pelipper
description_en: It scoops up Wishiwashi in its huge beak and swallows them whole. It can devour more than 30 at one go!
description_es: Pelipper guarda muchos Pokémon pequeños en su enorme pico y se los traga enteros.

name: Ralts
description_en: Ralts has the ability to sense the emotions of people. If its Trainer is in a cheerful mood, this Pokémon grows cheerful and joyous in the same way.
