description_es: Ralts percibe las emociones de las personas y comparte la alegría de su entrenador.

name: Kirlia
description_en: Kirlia uses the horns on its head to amplify its psychokinetic power. When the Pokémon uses its power, the air around it becomes distorted, creating mirages of nonexistent scenery.
description_es: Los cuernos de Kirlia amplifican sus poderes psíquicos y crean espejismos en el aire.

name: Gardevoir
description_en: Gardevoir has the psychokinetic power to distort the dimensions and create a small black hole. This Pokémon will try to protect its Trainer even at the risk of its own life.
description_es: Gardevoir puede deformar el espacio y generar pequeños agujeros negros para proteger a su entrenador.

name: Surskit
description_en: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.
description_es: Surskit vive en charcas llenas de vegetación y compite con Dewpider por alimento y territorio.

name: Masquerain
description_en: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.
description_es: Las delicadas antenas de Masquerain absorben humedad; se refugia en huecos de árboles durante la lluvia.

name: Shroomish
description_en: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.
description_es: Shroomish esparce esporas muy tóxicas que pueden marchitar incluso los árboles.

name: Breloom
description_en: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.
description_es: Las semillas de la cola de Breloom contienen esporas endurecidas que resultan tóxicas al ingerirlas.

name: Slakoth
description_en: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.
description_es: Slakoth apenas se mueve y su corazón late muy lentamente, incluso en situaciones agitadas.

name: Vigoroth
description_en: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.
description_es: Vigoroth no puede quedarse quieto y suele correr frenéticamente antes de conseguir dormirse.

name: Slaking
description_en: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.
description_es: Slaking come hierba sin levantarse y deja grandes círculos sin vegetación a su alrededor.

name: Nincada
description_en: Nincada lives underground. It uses its sharp claws to carve the roots of trees and absorb moisture and nutrients. This Pokémon can’t withstand bright sunlight so avoids it.
description_es: Nincada vive bajo tierra y utiliza sus garras para extraer humedad de las raíces.

name: Ninjask
description_en: If Ninjask is not trained properly, it will refuse to obey the Trainer and cry loudly continuously. Because of this quality, this Pokémon is said to be one that puts the Trainer’s abilities to the test.
description_es: Ninjask exige entrenadores expertos; si no está bien entrenado, desobedece y grita continuamente.

name: Shedinja
description_en: Shedinja is a peculiar Pokémon. It seems to appear unsought in a Poké Ball after a Nincada evolves. This bizarre Pokémon is entirely immobile—it doesn’t even breathe.
description_es: Shedinja aparece misteriosamente tras evolucionar Nincada y parece inmóvil e incapaz de respirar.

name: Whismur
description_en: Whismur is very timid. If it starts to cry loudly, it becomes startled by its own crying and cries even harder. When it finally stops crying, the Pokémon goes to sleep, all tired out.
description_es: Whismur se asusta con sus propios llantos y termina agotado después de llorar intensamente.

name: Loudred
description_en: Loudred shouts while stamping its feet. After it finishes shouting, this Pokémon becomes incapable of hearing anything for a while. This is considered to be a weak point.
description_es: Loudred grita mientras golpea el suelo, pero después queda temporalmente sordo.

name: Exploud
description_en: Exploud communicates its feelings to the others by emitting whistle-like sounds from the tubes on its body. This Pokémon only raises its voice when it is in battle.
description_es: Exploud se comunica con sonidos que salen de los tubos de su cuerpo y grita al combatir.

name: Makuhita
description_en: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.
description_es: Según un rumor, existe una receta tradicional que ayuda a criar Makuhita especialmente fuertes.

name: Hariyama
description_en: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.
description_es: No todos los Hariyama grandes son los más fuertes; algunos pequeños combaten con mucha agilidad.

name: Azurill
description_en: Azurill’s tail is large and bouncy. It is packed full of the nutrients this Pokémon needs to grow. Azurill can be seen bouncing and playing on its big, rubbery tail.
description_es: Azurill acumula nutrientes en su gran cola elástica y juega rebotando sobre ella.

name: Nosepass
description_en: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.
description_es: Nosepass atrae presas con magnetismo sin moverse, aunque a veces atrae enemigos peligrosos.

name: Skitty
description_en: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.
description_es: Skitty persigue juguetonamente su cola y es una mascota muy apreciada por su aspecto adorable.

name: Delcatty
description_en: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.
description_es: Delcatty duerme donde quiere y prefiere marcharse antes que pelear con quien lo moleste.

name: Sableye
description_en: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.
description_es: Los minerales que come Sableye producen dibujos distintos en las gemas que aparecen por su cuerpo.

name: Mawile
description_en: It has two mouths. The big jaws on the back of its head can’t taste anything, so that’s the mouth it uses to eat foods it doesn’t like.
description_es: Mawile tiene dos bocas; utiliza las grandes mandíbulas traseras para comer lo que no le gusta.

name: Aron
description_en: Aron has a body of steel. With one all-out charge, this Pokémon can demolish even a heavy dump truck. The destroyed dump truck then becomes a handy meal for the Pokémon.
description_es: Aron posee un cuerpo de acero, puede destrozar camiones y alimentarse del metal resultante.

name: Lairon
description_en: Lairon feeds on iron contained in rocks and water. It makes its nest on mountains where iron ore is buried. As a result, the Pokémon often clashes with humans mining the iron ore.
description_es: Lairon se alimenta del hierro de las rocas y vive en montañas ricas en minerales.

name: Aggron
description_en: Aggron is protective of its environment. If its mountain is ravaged by a landslide or a fire, this Pokémon will haul topsoil to the area, plant trees, and beautifully restore its own territory.
description_es: Aggron protege su montaña y repara los daños causados por incendios o desprendimientos.

name: Meditite
description_en: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.
description_es: Meditite aumenta su energía mediante la meditación y sobrevive comiendo muy poco.

name: Medicham
description_en: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.
description_es: Medicham desarrolló poderes psíquicos mediante la meditación y puede pasar un mes sin comer.

name: Electrike
description_en: Static electricity builds up all over its body as strands of its long fur rub together. This Pokémon boasts incredible speed.
description_es: Electrike acumula electricidad estática en su pelo al rozarlo y alcanza velocidades impresionantes.

name: Manectric
description_en: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
description_es: Manectric estimula sus músculos con electricidad para correr y recuperarse rápidamente del esfuerzo.

name: Plusle
description_en: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.
description_es: Plusle anima a sus compañeros soltando chispas y llora si pierden una batalla.

name: Minun
description_en: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.
description_es: Minun apoya a sus compañeros en combate y produce más chispas cuando están en peligro.

name: Volbeat
description_en: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.
description_es: Volbeat ilumina la noche dibujando figuras con su cola y adora el aroma de Illumise.

name: Illumise
description_en: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.
description_es: Illumise dirige grupos de Volbeat que trazan símbolos luminosos en el cielo nocturno.

name: Roselia
description_en: On extremely rare occasions, a Roselia is said to appear with its flowers in unusual colors. The thorns on this Pokémon’s head contain a vicious poison.
description_es: En ocasiones rarísimas, Roselia presenta flores de colores extraños y espinas con veneno potente.

name: Gulpin
description_en: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.
description_es: Casi todo el cuerpo de Gulpin es estómago, donde unas enzimas disuelven cualquier sustancia.

name: Swalot
description_en: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.
description_es: Swalot no tiene dientes y traga enteros objetos enormes gracias a su boca descomunal.

name: Carvanha
description_en: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.
description_es: Carvanha destroza barcos de madera con sus mandíbulas y pelea con Basculin por alimento.

name: Sharpedo
description_en: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It’s very sensitive to the scent of blood.
description_es: Sharpedo se impulsa expulsando agua a presión y detecta hasta el olor más leve de sangre.

name: Wailmer
description_en: Due to their memories of when they once lived on land, pods of them will, very rarely, wash up on shore.
description_es: Algunas manadas de Wailmer llegan accidentalmente a la costa, como recuerdo de un pasado terrestre.

name: Wailord
description_en: When a small Wailmer is attacked by Sharpedo or Dhelmise, its whole pod works together to protect it.
description_es: Los Wailord de una manada se unen para proteger a los Wailmer pequeños de los depredadores.

name: Numel
description_en: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.
description_es: Numel guarda magma caliente dentro de su cuerpo, pero el agua lo enfría y vuelve lento.

name: Camerupt
description_en: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.
description_es: Las jorobas de Camerupt contienen magma que puede entrar en erupción cuando se enfada.

name: Torkoal
description_en: It burns coal to produce energy. When it has burned through all of its coal, it becomes unable to move.
description_es: Torkoal quema carbón para conseguir energía y deja de moverse cuando se le agota.

name: Spoink
description_en: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.
description_es: La perla de Spoink amplifica sus poderes psíquicos y siempre busca otra más grande.

name: Grumpig
description_en: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.
description_es: Grumpig utiliza las perlas negras de su cuerpo para canalizar poderes psíquicos mientras baila.

name: Spinda
description_en: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!
description_es: Cada Spinda tiene un patrón de manchas diferente y esquiva ataques con movimientos tambaleantes.

name: Trapinch
description_en: It builds nests that double as traps, lying in wait for its prey to get caught. When night falls, it digs itself a spot beneath the sand to sleep.
description_es: Trapinch cava pozos que sirven de trampas para atrapar presas y refugiarse en la arena.

name: Vibrava
description_en: It vibrates its wings to send out odd sound waves. Trainers who are with it need earplugs.
description_es: Vibrava produce extrañas ondas sonoras al vibrar sus alas; sus entrenadores necesitan tapones.

name: Flygon
description_en: People continue to have their hearts stolen by its enchanting songs and find themselves stranded in the desert.
description_es: Las canciones de Flygon cautivan a los viajeros y pueden hacer que se pierdan en el desierto.

name: Cacnea
description_en: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.
description_es: Cuanto más árido es el entorno, más bellas y fragantes son las flores de Cacnea.

name: Cacturne
description_en: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.
description_es: Los grupos de Cacturne siguen a viajeros nocturnos por el desierto hasta que se agotan.

name: Swablu
description_en: Swablu loves to make things clean. If it spots something dirty, it will wipe and polish it with its cottony wings. If its wings become dirty, this Pokémon finds a stream and showers itself.
description_es: Swablu limpia objetos con sus alas algodonosas y las lava en arroyos cuando se ensucian.

name: Altaria
description_en: Altaria sings in a gorgeous soprano. Its wings are like cotton clouds. This Pokémon catches updrafts with its buoyant wings and soars way up into the wild blue yonder.
description_es: Altaria canta con hermosa voz y se eleva entre corrientes de aire con sus alas nubosas.

name: Zangoose
description_en: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.
description_es: Zangoose tiene garras afiladas y mantiene una rivalidad feroz y ancestral con Seviper.

name: Seviper
description_en: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.
description_es: Seviper ataca con su cola como espada y nunca abandona su enemistad con Zangoose.

name: Lunatone
description_en: Lunatone becomes active around the time of the full moon. Instead of walking, it moves by floating in midair. The Pokémon’s intimidating red eyes cause all those who see it to become transfixed with fear.
description_es: Lunatone flota en el aire y se activa durante la luna llena; sus ojos rojos intimidan.

name: Solrock
description_en: Sunlight is the source of Solrock’s power. It is said to possess the ability to read the emotions of others. This Pokémon gives off intense heat while rotating its body.
description_es: Solrock absorbe energía solar, lee emociones y libera calor intenso mientras gira.

name: Barboach
description_en: Its whiskers are filled with nerves. They can sense smells and flavors just as a person’s nose or tongue would.
description_es: Los bigotes de Barboach perciben olores y sabores gracias a su gran sensibilidad nerviosa.

name: Whiscash
description_en: Its vision is not that good. It senses vibrations in the water with its whiskers to determine the location of its prey.
description_es: Whiscash localiza a sus presas detectando las vibraciones del agua con sus bigotes.

name: Corphish
description_en: It can adapt very well to its environment. Feebas and Corphish are about the only Pokémon to live in stagnant ditches.
description_es: Corphish se adapta a casi cualquier ambiente y puede habitar zanjas de agua estancada.

name: Crawdaunt
description_en: Its pincers often fall off. Unlike with Crabrawler or Clauncher, the meat in its claws is utterly nasty and stinking.
description_es: Crawdaunt pierde frecuentemente las pinzas, cuya carne desprende un olor extremadamente desagradable.

name: Baltoy
description_en: When they find others of their kind, they cry out loudly and gather together. Large numbers of them can be found in old graveyards.
description_es: Los Baltoy se reúnen ruidosamente cuando encuentran otros de su especie y habitan cementerios antiguos.

name: Claydol
description_en: The ancient people who made it apparently modeled it after something that descended from the sky. It fires beams from both arms.
description_es: Claydol fue modelado por pueblos antiguos a semejanza de algo que descendió del cielo.

name: Lileep
description_en: It sticks to rocks with its powerful suckers and can’t be washed away no matter how rough the surf gets.
description_es: Lileep se fija a las rocas con ventosas tan fuertes que las olas no pueden arrancarlo.

name: Cradily
description_en: This carnivorous Pokémon lived in primordial seas. It catches prey in its eight tentacles and dissolves them with digestive fluid as it eats.
description_es: Cradily atrapaba presas con sus ocho tentáculos y las digería en los mares primitivos.

name: Anorith
description_en: This is one kind of primeval bug Pokémon. With eight wings, it could apparently swim a lot faster than you’d expect.
description_es: Anorith es un Pokémon fósil con ocho alas que le permitían nadar rápidamente.

name: Armaldo
description_en: Armaldo adapted from living in water to living on land. It has been determined that it is the ancestor of some bug Pokémon.
description_es: Armaldo pasó de vivir en el agua a tierra firme y podría ser antepasado de algunos insectos.

name: Feebas
description_en: Because of its wretched appearance, most people pay it no attention, but there are some who collect Feebas—and Feebas alone!
description_es: La apariencia de Feebas hace que la mayoría lo ignore, aunque existen coleccionistas especializados.

name: Milotic
description_en: Its dwelling place is the bottom of big lakes. Those who behold its loveliness are said to have their hearts purified.
description_es: Milotic habita el fondo de grandes lagos y su belleza supuestamente purifica el corazón.

name: Castform
description_en: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!
description_es: Castform cambia de forma según el clima y se vuelve más irritable con condiciones extremas.

name: Kecleon
description_en: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.
description_es: Kecleon modifica su color para ocultarse o reflejar su ánimo y estado de salud.

name: Shuppet
description_en: There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”
description_es: Shuppet aparece al anochecer y, según un refrán, conviene evitar las casas donde se reúne.

name: Banette
description_en: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.
description_es: Banette nació del rencor de un juguete abandonado; tratarlo bien podría devolverlo a su estado original.

name: Duskull
description_en: Duskull wanders lost among the deep darkness of midnight. There is an oft-told admonishment given to misbehaving children that this Pokémon will spirit away bad children who earn scoldings from their mothers.
description_es: Duskull merodea de noche y protagoniza historias con que se asusta a niños desobedientes.

name: Dusclops
description_en: Dusclops absorbs anything, however large the object may be. This Pokémon hypnotizes its foe by waving its hands in a macabre manner and by bringing its single eye to bear. The hypnotized foe is made to do Dusclops’s bidding.
description_es: Dusclops puede absorber objetos enormes y controlar a sus rivales mediante hipnosis.

name: Tropius
description_en: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.
description_es: Tropius lleva racimos de frutas deliciosas alrededor del cuello y se cría en regiones cálidas.

name: Chimecho
description_en: In high winds, Chimecho cries as it hangs from a tree branch or the eaves of a building using a suction cup on its head. This Pokémon plucks berries with its long tail and eats them.
description_es: Chimecho cuelga de ramas y aleros mediante una ventosa y recoge bayas con su cola.

name: Absol
description_en: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.
description_es: Absol predice catástrofes, aunque algunas personas lo detestan por asociarlo con desastres.

name: Wynaut
description_en: Wynaut gather on moonlit nights to play by squeezing up against each other. By being squeezed, this Pokémon gains endurance and is trained to dole out powerful counterattacks.
description_es: Los Wynaut se reúnen bajo la luna para apretujarse y desarrollar resistencia.

name: Snorunt
description_en: Rich people from cold areas all share childhood memories of playing with Snorunt.
description_es: Muchas personas de regiones frías recuerdan haber jugado con Snorunt durante su infancia.

name: Glalie
description_en: Its actual body is a rock that isn’t particularly hard. Glalie absorbs moisture from the air and drapes itself in an armor of ice.
description_es: Glalie rodea su cuerpo rocoso con una coraza helada formada de humedad del aire.

name: Spheal
description_en: Spheal always travels by rolling around on its ball-like body. When the season for ice floes arrives, this Pokémon can be seen rolling about on ice and crossing the sea.
description_es: Spheal rueda para desplazarse y llega a atravesar mares sobre placas de hielo.

name: Sealeo
description_en: Sealeo often balances and rolls things on the tip of its nose. While the Pokémon is rolling something, it checks the object’s aroma and texture to determine whether it likes the object or not.
description_es: Sealeo equilibra objetos en el hocico y examina su olor y textura al hacerlos girar.

name: Walrein
description_en: Walrein swims all over in frigid seawater while crushing icebergs with its grand, imposing tusks. Its thick layer of blubber makes enemy attacks bounce off harmlessly.
description_es: Walrein rompe icebergs con sus grandes colmillos y su gruesa grasa lo protege de ataques.

name: Clamperl
description_en: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.
description_es: Las perlas de Clamperl son muy valiosas y pueden costar mucho más que las de Shellder.

name: Huntail
description_en: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.
description_es: Huntail vive en aguas profundas y su llegada a las costas se considera un mal presagio.

name: Gorebyss
description_en: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.
description_es: Gorebyss succiona fluidos corporales de sus presas y deja los restos en el fondo marino.

name: Relicanth
description_en: The reason it hasn’t changed at all in a hundred million years is that it’s apparently already a perfect life-form.
description_es: Relicanth no ha cambiado durante millones de años, quizá porque ya posee una forma perfecta.

name: Luvdisc
description_en: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.
description_es: Luvdisc vive entre arrecifes coralinos de mares cálidos y duerme entre ramas de Corsola.

name: Bagon
description_en: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.
description_es: Bagon golpea objetos con la cabeza; se cree que esos choques estimulan su evolución.

name: Shelgon
description_en: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.
description_es: Shelgon vive en cuevas y espera dentro de su duro caparazón el día en que podrá volar.

name: Salamence
description_en: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart’s desire—wings.
description_es: Salamence desarrolló alas gracias a sus deseos intensos de poder volar.

name: Beldum
description_en: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.
description_es: Beldum crea campos magnéticos tan fuertes que puede averiar máquinas cuando se enfada.

name: Metang
description_en: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.
description_es: Metang vuela rápido y captura presas con sus garras afiladas sin soltarlas.

name: Metagross
description_en: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.
description_es: Metagross analiza adversarios con una precisión superior a la de un superordenador.

name: Regirock
description_en: Regirock’s body is composed entirely of rocks. Recently, a study made the startling discovery that the rocks were all unearthed from different locations.
description_es: Regirock está formado por rocas procedentes de muchos lugares diferentes.

name: Regice
description_en: Regice cloaks itself with frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit. Things will freeze solid just by going near this Pokémon. Its icy body is so cold, it will not melt even if it is immersed in magma.
description_es: Regice desprende un frío extremo que congela cualquier cosa cercana y no se derrite en magma.

name: Registeel
description_en: Registeel was imprisoned by people in ancient times. The metal composing its body is thought to be a curious substance that is not of this earth.
description_es: Registeel fue encerrado en la antigüedad; el metal de su cuerpo podría ser extraterrestre.

name: Latias
description_en: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
description_es: Latias entiende el lenguaje humano y refracta la luz con su plumón para cambiar de apariencia.

name: Latios
description_en: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
description_es: Latios confía solo en entrenadores compasivos y vuela más rápido que un avión.

name: Kyogre
description_en: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
description_es: Kyogre personifica el mar y protagoniza leyendas de enfrentamientos contra Groudon.

name: Groudon
description_en: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.
description_es: Groudon recupera su forma primigenia para expandir la tierra mediante erupciones de magma.

name: Rayquaza
description_en: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.
description_es: Rayquaza recorre la capa de ozono comiendo meteoritos que le permiten megaevolucionar.

name: Jirachi
description_en: Jirachi will awaken from its sleep of a thousand years if you sing to it in a voice of purity. It is said to make true any wish that people desire.
description_es: Jirachi despierta con un canto puro tras largos periodos dormido y concede deseos según la leyenda.

name: Deoxys
description_en: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
description_es: Deoxys surgió de un virus espacial y emite rayos láser desde el cristal de su pecho.

name: Turtwig
description_en: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.
description_es: Turtwig realiza fotosíntesis con su cuerpo y la hoja de su cabeza se marchita cuando tiene sed.

name: Grotle
description_en: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
description_es: Grotle conoce los manantiales de agua pura y lleva a otros Pokémon hasta ellos sobre su espalda.

name: Torterra
description_en: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
description_es: Pequeños Pokémon construyen nidos sobre la enorme espalda inmóvil de Torterra.

name: Chimchar
description_en: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
description_es: Chimchar expulsa fuego desde la parte trasera de su cuerpo; su llama se debilita al enfermar.

name: Monferno
description_en: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.
description_es: Monferno utiliza paredes y techos para atacar desde el aire mientras combate con su cola ardiente.

name: Infernape
description_en: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
description_es: Infernape pelea con gran agilidad, usando sus cuatro extremidades en un estilo propio.

name: Piplup
description_en: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
description_es: Piplup es muy orgulloso y rechaza la comida de las personas; su plumón lo protege del frío.

name: Prinplup
description_en: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
description_es: Prinplup vive solo y golpea con alas tan fuertes que pueden quebrar árboles gruesos.

name: Empoleon
description_en: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
description_es: Los tres cuernos del pico de Empoleon indican su poder; el líder tiene los mayores.

name: Starly
description_en: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
description_es: Starly vive en bandadas ruidosas que persiguen Pokémon insecto por campos y montañas.

name: Staravia
description_en: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
description_es: Staravia habita bosques y campos y pelea por territorios cuando se encuentran dos bandadas.

name: Staraptor
description_en: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
description_es: Staraptor abandona su bandada al evolucionar y vive en solitario con sus alas resistentes.

name: Bidoof
description_en: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.
description_es: Bidoof roe troncos y piedras constantemente para desgastar sus incisivos y anida cerca del agua.

name: Bibarel
description_en: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
description_es: Bibarel construye presas con ramas y barro y destaca por ser un trabajador incansable.

name: Kricketot
description_en: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
description_es: Las antenas de Kricketot producen sonidos parecidos a un xilófono cuando chocan entre sí.

name: Kricketune
description_en: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.
description_es: Kricketune expresa emociones mediante melodías que los científicos estudian cuidadosamente.

name: Shinx
description_en: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
description_es: El pelaje de Shinx brilla al detectar peligro y deslumbra a sus enemigos para escapar.

name: Luxio
description_en: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
description_es: Las garras de Luxio conducen tanta electricidad que un simple arañazo puede desmayar a un rival.

name: Luxray
description_en: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
description_es: Luxray ve a través de los objetos y usa esa habilidad para descubrir amenazas ocultas.

name: Budew
description_en: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
description_es: Budew cierra su capullo durante el invierno y libera polen al abrirse en primavera.

name: Roserade
description_en: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.
description_es: Roserade pelea con elegancia de bailarín, utilizando látigos cubiertos de espinas venenosas.

name: Cranidos
description_en: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.
description_es: Cranidos tenía un cráneo muy duro y derribaba árboles a cabezazos para comer sus bayas.

name: Rampardos
description_en: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.
description_es: Rampardos atacaba a cabezazos; algunas teorías relacionan su pequeño cerebro con su extinción.

name: Shieldon
description_en: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.
description_es: Los fósiles de Shieldon solo han permitido descubrir su cara, nunca el resto del cuerpo.

name: Bastiodon
description_en: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.
description_es: Bastiodon vivió hace millones de años y tiene un rostro más resistente que el acero.

name: Burmy
description_en: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
description_es: Burmy reconstruye rápidamente su manto protector con materiales cercanos cuando lo pierde en combate.

name: Wormadam
description_en: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
description_es: Al evolucionar, el manto de Wormadam se fusiona con su cuerpo y ya no se desprende.

name: Mothim
description_en: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
description_es: Mothim revolotea de noche y roba miel de las colmenas de Combee.

name: Combee
description_en: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.
description_es: Combee recolecta miel para su colonia y duerme formando grandes grupos semejantes a una colmena.

name: Vespiquen
description_en: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.
description_es: Vespiquen cría larvas en el abdomen y las alimenta con la miel que recolectan los Combee.

name: Pachirisu
description_en: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
description_es: Pachirisu comparte electricidad con otros de su especie frotando las bolsas de sus mejillas.

name: Buizel
description_en: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
description_es: Buizel infla el flotador de su cuello y asoma la cabeza para observar lo que ocurre.

name: Floatzel
description_en: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
description_es: El flotador de Floatzel apareció al perseguir presas acuáticas y puede servir de balsa.

name: Cherubi
description_en: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.
description_es: Cherubi evoluciona absorbiendo la energía acumulada en la pequeña bola de su cuerpo.

name: Cherrim
description_en: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
description_es: Cherrim abre sus pétalos con la luz solar intensa para absorber energía con todo el cuerpo.

name: Shellos
description_en: When it senses danger, a purple liquid oozes out of it. The liquid is thought to be something like greasy sweat.
description_es: Shellos libera un líquido morado cuando percibe peligro, parecido a sudor aceitoso.

name: Gastrodon
description_en: Their shape and color change, depending on their environment and diet. There are many of them at beaches where the waves are calm.
description_es: La forma y el color de Gastrodon cambian según su dieta y su entorno.

name: Ambipom
description_en: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.
description_es: Ambipom utiliza las dos colas para cualquier tarea y abraza con ellas a quien quiere.

name: Drifloon
description_en: Wandering souls gathered together to form this Pokémon. When trying to make friends with children, Drifloon grabs them by the hand.
description_es: Drifloon nació de almas errantes y toma de la mano a niños cuando intenta hacer amigos.

name: Drifblim
description_en: The raw material for the gas inside its body is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it’s thought to carry away people and Pokémon.
description_es: Drifblim contiene gases formados por almas y, al desinflarse, podría llevarse a personas o Pokémon.

name: Buneary
description_en: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it’s attacked by an enemy.
description_es: Buneary mantiene una oreja enrollada para contraatacar rápidamente si alguien lo ataca.

name: Lopunny
description_en: It’s notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.
description_es: Lopunny evita las peleas, pero puede lanzar patadas formidables con sus patas estilizadas.

name: Mismagius
description_en: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.
description_es: Los conjuros de Mismagius pueden provocar terribles dolores de cabeza y visiones aterradoras.

name: Honchkrow
description_en: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.
description_es: Honchkrow deja que sus subordinados peleen y solo interviene para dar el golpe final.

name: Glameow
description_en: When it’s happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
description_es: Glameow expresa su alegría con elegantes movimientos de cola parecidos a una cinta de baile.

name: Purugly
description_en: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
description_es: Purugly se ajusta la cintura con sus dos colas para parecer más robusto e intimidante.

name: Chingling
description_en: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
description_es: Dentro de la boca de Chingling hay una esfera que repica cuando da saltos.

name: Stunky
description_en: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
description_es: Stunky se defiende expulsando un líquido maloliente cuyo hedor dura todo un día.

name: Skuntank
description_en: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.
description_es: Skuntank expulsa líquido fétido por la cola y su olor empeora con el tiempo.

name: Bronzor
description_en: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
description_es: En tumbas antiguas se encontraron objetos con forma de Bronzor; se desconoce si están relacionados.

name: Bronzong
description_en: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.
description_es: Antiguamente se pedía lluvia a Bronzong para favorecer el crecimiento de los cultivos.

name: Bonsly
description_en: If its body gets too damp, it will die. So, in a process reminiscent of sweating, its eyes expel moisture.
description_es: Bonsly puede morir si absorbe demasiada humedad; elimina agua por los ojos como si sudara.

name: Mime Jr.
description_en: When this gifted mimic surprises an opponent, Mime Jr. feels so happy that it ends up forgetting it was imitating something.
description_es: Mime Jr. imita a otros tan bien que se emociona y olvida que estaba copiándolos.

name: Happiny
description_en: When it sees something round and white, Happiny puts it into the pouch on its stomach. It sometimes becomes overloaded and can’t move.
description_es: Happiny guarda objetos redondos y blancos en la bolsa de su vientre, aunque a veces acumula demasiados.

name: Chatot
description_en: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
description_es: Chatot aprende y pronuncia palabras humanas; los grupos suelen repetir las mismas expresiones.

name: Spiritomb
description_en: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.
description_es: Spiritomb fue encerrado en una piedra extraña como castigo por sus fechorías hace siglos.

name: Gible
description_en: Its original home is an area much hotter than Alola. If you’re planning to live with one, your heating bill will soar.
description_es: Gible procede de regiones calurosas y necesita mucho calor si vive con un entrenador.

name: Gabite
description_en: It sheds its skin and gradually grows larger. Its scales can be ground into a powder and used as raw materials for traditional medicine.
description_es: Gabite muda de piel al crecer y sus escamas se utilizan en remedios tradicionales.

name: Garchomp
description_en: Its fine scales don’t just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.
description_es: Las escamas de Garchomp reducen la resistencia del aire y cortan a quienes lo atacan.

name: Munchlax
description_en: Anything that looks edible, Munchlax will go on and swallow whole. Its stomach is tough enough to handle it even if the food has gone rotten.
description_es: Munchlax se come cualquier cosa que parezca comestible, incluso alimentos podridos.

name: Riolu
description_en: It uses waves called auras to communicate with others of its kind. It doesn’t make any noise during this time, so its enemies can’t detect it.
description_es: Riolu se comunica sin sonido mediante ondas de aura que sus enemigos no pueden detectar.

name: Lucario
description_en: Lucario reads its opponent’s feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.
description_es: Lucario percibe sentimientos ajenos con el aura, aunque saber demasiado a veces lo estresa.

name: Hippopotas
description_en: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.
description_es: Hippopotas se cubre de arena para evitar gérmenes y detesta mojarse.

name: Hippowdon
description_en: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
description_es: Hippowdon expulsa arena almacenada en su cuerpo para crear enormes remolinos durante el ataque.

name: Skorupi
description_en: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.
description_es: Skorupi espera bajo la arena y paraliza a sus presas con las pinzas venenosas de la cola.

name: Drapion
description_en: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
description_es: Las poderosas pinzas de Drapion pueden destrozar automóviles y segregar un veneno peligroso.

name: Croagunk
description_en: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.
description_es: Croagunk infla bolsas venenosas y emite sonidos extraños antes de atacar con sus puños tóxicos.

name: Toxicroak
description_en: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
description_es: Las garras de Toxicroak liberan un veneno tan potente que un rasguño puede ser mortal.

name: Carnivine
description_en: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
description_es: Carnivine se aferra a árboles pantanosos y atrae presas con saliva dulce antes de devorarlas.

name: Finneon
description_en: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.
description_es: Finneon atrae presas con sus aletas luminosas y se sumerge durante la noche.

name: Lumineon
description_en: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.
description_es: Lumineon recorre aguas profundas y sus aletas brillan como estrellas en el fondo del mar.

name: Mantyke
description_en: Mantyke are friendly toward people and will approach boats closely. The patterns on their backs differ depending on their habitat.
description_es: Mantyke es amistoso y se acerca a barcos; los dibujos de su espalda varían según el hábitat.

name: Snover
description_en: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.
description_es: Snover produce en primavera bayas de textura helada alrededor del vientre.

name: Abomasnow
description_en: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
description_es: Abomasnow vive tranquilamente en montañas nevadas y se oculta provocando ventiscas.

name: Weavile
description_en: Thanks to its increased intelligence, scrapping over food is a thing of the past. A scratch from its claws will give you a case of frostbite!
description_es: Weavile es inteligente, ya no disputa alimento y sus garras pueden causar congelación.

name: Magnezone
description_en: There are still people who believe that this Pokémon came from outer space. It emanates a powerful magnetic field.
description_es: Magnezone crea un campo magnético poderoso y algunos creen que proviene del espacio.

name: Lickilicky
description_en: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.
description_es: Lickilicky maneja su lengua con extraordinaria precisión, incluso para recoger objetos diminutos.

name: Rhyperior
description_en: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.
description_es: Rhyperior dispara piedras desde agujeros de las palmas y a veces utiliza Geodude.

name: Tangrowth
description_en: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.
description_es: Las lianas de Tangrowth crecen tanto en estaciones cálidas que llegan a ocultarle los ojos.

name: Electivire
description_en: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.
description_es: Un solo Electivire puede generar electricidad suficiente para abastecer una ciudad durante un año.

name: Magmortar
description_en: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.
description_es: Magmortar dispara bolas de fuego muy calientes, aunque evita usarlas para cazar presas.

name: Togekiss
description_en: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
description_es: Togekiss comparte bendiciones con personas pacíficas que se respetan entre sí.

name: Yanmega
description_en: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
description_es: Yanmega tiene seis patas y puede transportar a una persona adulta mientras vuela.

name: Leafeon
description_en: It gets its nutrition from photosynthesis. It lives a quiet life deep in forests where clean rivers flow.
description_es: Leafeon obtiene alimento por fotosíntesis y vive tranquilamente entre bosques y ríos limpios.

name: Glaceon
description_en: It can instantaneously freeze any moisture that’s around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at its prey.
description_es: Glaceon congela de inmediato la humedad ambiental y dispara proyectiles de hielo a sus presas.

name: Gliscor
description_en: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
description_es: Gliscor vuela sin hacer ruido, atrapa presas con su larga cola y después las muerde.

name: Mamoswine
description_en: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
description_es: Mamoswine tiene enormes colmillos de hielo; su población disminuyó al acabar la era glacial.

name: Porygon-Z
description_en: A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.
description_es: Un error en una actualización informática alteró el comportamiento de Porygon-Z.

name: Gallade
description_en: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
description_es: Gallade domina la cortesía y la esgrima, y lucha con espadas que surgen de sus codos.

name: Probopass
description_en: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.
description_es: Probopass dirige tres pequeñas unidades que cazan y combaten, mientras su cuerpo principal da órdenes.

name: Dusknoir
description_en: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
description_es: La antena de Dusknoir recibe señales del mundo espiritual que lo llaman a llevarse personas.

name: Froslass
description_en: It’s said that on nights of terrible blizzards, it comes down to human settlements. If you hear it knocking at your door, do not open it!
description_es: Se cuenta que Froslass desciende a las aldeas durante ventiscas terribles y llama a las puertas.

name: Rotom
description_en: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
description_es: Rotom está compuesto de plasma y se infiltra en dispositivos electrónicos para causar problemas.

name: Uxie
description_en: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.
description_es: Según la leyenda, la aparición de Uxie otorgó a la humanidad la inteligencia.

name: Mesprit
description_en: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.
description_es: Mesprit duerme en el fondo de un lago y su espíritu parece volar sobre la superficie.

name: Azelf
description_en: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
description_es: Se cree que Uxie, Mesprit y Azelf proceden de un mismo huevo.

name: Dialga
description_en: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
description_es: Dialga domina el tiempo y aparece como una deidad antigua en las leyendas de Sinnoh.

name: Palkia
description_en: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
description_es: Palkia puede deformar el espacio y figura como divinidad en la mitología de Sinnoh.

name: Heatran
description_en: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
description_es: La sangre de Heatran hierve como magma y habita cuevas volcánicas.

name: Regigigas
description_en: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
description_es: Una leyenda asegura que Regigigas arrastró continentes enteros utilizando cuerdas.

name: Giratina
description_en: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
description_es: Giratina fue desterrado por su violencia y observa el mundo desde el Mundo Distorsión.

name: Cresselia
description_en: Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description_es: Una pluma de Cresselia supuestamente garantiza sueños felices a quien duerme con ella.

name: Phione
description_en: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
description_es: Phione flota en mares cálidos y siempre vuelve a su lugar de nacimiento.

name: Manaphy
description_en: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
description_es: Manaphy nace con la capacidad extraordinaria de crear vínculos con cualquier Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
description_en: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
description_es: Darkrai provoca sueños y hace dormir a las personas; está activo en noches de luna nueva.

name: Shaymin
description_en: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.
description_es: Shaymin puede volar gracias a las flores Gracídea y simboliza los sentimientos de gratitud.

name: Arceus
description_en: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
description_es: Según la mitología, Arceus nació antes de que existiera el universo.

name: Victini
description_en: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.
description_es: Victini comparte una energía infinita capaz de llenar de poder a quienes reciben su ayuda.

name: Snivy
description_en: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
description_es: Snivy realiza fotosíntesis con la cola al sol; cuando se siente mal, la deja caer.

name: Servine
description_en: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
description_es: Servine mantiene limpias sus hojas porque la suciedad dificulta la fotosíntesis.

name: Serperior
description_en: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
description_es: Serperior puede inmovilizar a sus enemigos con la mirada y acumula energía solar.

name: Tepig
description_en: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
description_es: Tepig adora las bayas asadas, aunque a veces se entusiasma y acaba quemándolas.

name: Pignite
description_en: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
description_es: Pignite se mueve más rápido cuando su fuego interior se intensifica y expulsa humo en apuros.

name: Emboar
description_en: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
description_es: Emboar domina movimientos de combate rápidos y poderosos y luce una barba de fuego.

name: Oshawott
description_en: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
description_es: Oshawott lucha con la vieira de su vientre y contraataca inmediatamente con golpes cortantes.

name: Dewott
description_en: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
description_es: Dewott desarrolla su propio estilo para usar las vieiras gracias a un entrenamiento riguroso.

name: Samurott
description_en: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
description_es: Samurott derrota adversarios con un solo movimiento de su espada y silencia multitudes con la mirada.

name: Patrat
description_en: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
description_es: Patrat vigila constantemente a sus alrededores, aunque no detecta enemigos que llegan por detrás.

name: Watchog
description_en: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
description_es: Watchog levanta la cola al ver enemigos y les escupe semillas guardadas en sus mejillas.

name: Lillipup
description_en: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it’s intelligent, obedient to its Trainer’s commands, and easy to raise.
description_es: Lillipup es inteligente, obediente y fácil de criar, por eso gusta a entrenadores principiantes.

name: Herdier
description_en: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.
description_es: Herdier convive con humanos desde hace tanto que aparece representado en antiguas pinturas rupestres.

name: Stoutland
description_en: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.
description_es: El pelaje grueso de Stoutland lo hizo habitual en hogares de regiones frías antiguamente.

name: Purrloin
description_en: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
description_es: Purrloin roba por diversión y suele ser perdonado gracias a su fingida ternura.

name: Liepard
description_en: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.
description_es: Liepard se acerca sigilosamente a sus víctimas y las ataca por la espalda.

name: Pansage
description_en: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
description_es: Pansage encuentra bayas con facilidad y las comparte generosamente con sus amigos.

name: Simisage
description_en: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
description_es: Simisage tiene mal carácter, combate con su cola espinosa y posee una hoja muy amarga.

name: Pansear
description_en: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es: Pansear vive en cuevas volcánicas y su mechón de pelo contiene llamas extremadamente calientes.

name: Simisear
description_en: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
description_es: Simisear desprende brasas al emocionarse y, curiosamente, le encantan los dulces.

name: Panpour
description_en: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
description_es: El agua de la mata de Panpour contiene nutrientes que ayudan a crecer a las plantas.

name: Simipour
description_en: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
description_es: Simipour necesita agua limpia y rellena la reserva de su cabeza usando la cola.

name: Munna
description_en: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.
description_es: Munna se alimenta de sueños y emite niebla rosada cuando consume uno agradable.

name: Musharna
description_en: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.
description_es: La niebla de los sueños de Musharna cambia de color según el contenido del sueño ingerido.

name: Pidove
description_en: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
description_es: Pidove está acostumbrado a los humanos y se reúne en bandadas en parques y plazas.

name: Tranquill
description_en: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
description_es: Tranquill siempre sabe dónde está su nido y nunca se pierde lejos de su entrenador.

name: Unfezant
description_en: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.
description_es: Los machos Unfezant tienen plumas en la cabeza y solo se encariñan con sus entrenadores.

name: Blitzle
description_en: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
description_es: Blitzle se comunica con destellos luminosos de su melena cuando libera electricidad.

name: Zebstrika
description_en: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
description_es: Zebstrika se desplaza como un rayo y su carrera resuena como un trueno.

name: Roggenrola
description_en: It was found in a fissure in a layer of exposed rock. The material that makes up its body is dirt from several hundred years ago.
description_es: Roggenrola fue descubierto en una grieta de roca y su cuerpo contiene tierra muy antigua.

name: Boldore
description_en: Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful energy. They’re valuable, so Boldore is sometimes targeted for them.
description_es: Los cristales naranjas de Boldore contienen energía valiosa y atraen a quienes desean obtenerlos.

name: Gigalith
description_en: It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It’s usually lurking deep beneath the surface.
description_es: Gigalith absorbe luz solar y dispara la energía acumulada desde las profundidades del suelo.

name: Woobat
description_en: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
description_es: La marca con forma de corazón que deja Woobat se considera un símbolo de buena suerte.

name: Swoobat
description_en: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
description_es: Las ondas ultrasónicas del macho Swoobat pueden mejorar el ánimo de quienes las reciben.

name: Drilbur
description_en: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
description_es: Drilbur gira sobre sí mismo para excavar tierra a gran velocidad.

name: Excadrill
description_en: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
description_es: Excadrill construye laberintos subterráneos muy profundos que a veces dañan túneles de metro.

name: Audino
description_en: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
description_es: Audino escucha los latidos de otros con los tentáculos de las orejas para conocer sus sentimientos.

name: Timburr
description_en: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
description_es: Timburr ayuda en obras de construcción cargando troncos cada vez mayores conforme crece.

name: Gurdurr
description_en: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
description_es: Gurdurr posee músculos tan fuertes que ni un grupo de luchadores puede moverlo.

name: Conkeldurr
description_en: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
description_es: Conkeldurr domina técnicas que aprovechan la fuerza centrífuga de grandes bloques de hormigón.

name: Tympole
description_en: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
description_es: Tympole emite sonidos inaudibles mediante las mejillas y se comunica por su ritmo.

name: Palpitoad
description_en: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
description_es: Palpitoad vive tanto en tierra como en agua e inmoviliza enemigos con su lengua pegajosa.

name: Seismitoad
description_en: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
description_es: Seismitoad lanza líquido paralizante desde los bultos de la cabeza y ataca con vibraciones.

name: Throh
description_en: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
description_es: Throh quiere derribar a rivales más grandes y cambia de cinturón al fortalecerse.

name: Sawk
description_en: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
description_es: Sawk se concentra apretando su cinturón y lanza puñetazos más potentes durante el entrenamiento.

name: Sewaddle
description_en: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
description_es: Sewaddle fabrica ropa con hojas y es un símbolo muy popular para los diseñadores de moda.

name: Swadloon
description_en: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
description_es: Swadloon se envuelve en hojas para protegerse del frío y las come en el bosque.

name: Leavanny
description_en: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
description_es: Leavanny utiliza hojas fermentadas para calentar huevos y fabricar mantas para los Sewaddle.

name: Venipede
description_en: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
description_es: La mordedura de Venipede inyecta veneno capaz de paralizar grandes Pokémon pájaro.

name: Whirlipede
description_en: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.
description_es: Whirlipede suele permanecer inmóvil, pero ante ataques gira rápidamente y embiste al enemigo.

name: Scolipede
description_en: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
description_es: Scolipede persigue a sus enemigos con gran rapidez y no deja de atacarlos con sus cuernos.

name: Cottonee
description_en: When attacked, it expels cotton from its body to create a diversion. The cotton it loses grows back in quickly.
description_es: Cottonee expulsa algodón para distraer a los agresores y lo regenera enseguida.

name: Whimsicott
description_en: Whimsicott doesn’t live in a fixed location. It floats around on whirling winds, appearing all over the place to perform its mischief.
description_es: Whimsicott viaja con el viento entre lugares distintos y disfruta haciendo travesuras.

name: Petilil
description_en: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.
description_es: Petilil prefiere agua y suelo limpios y se muda de zona cuando el ambiente empeora.

name: Lilligant
description_en: It’s well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
description_es: La belleza de Lilligant la hace popular; la flor de su cabeza necesita cuidados constantes.

name: Basculin
description_en: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That’s how violent Basculin are.
description_es: Las bandadas de Basculin son tan violentas que ahuyentan a casi todas las especies de un lago.

name: Sandile
description_en: Sandile’s still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It’s called “the cleaner of the desert.”
description_es: Sandile se alimenta de restos del desierto porque aún no caza bien y actúa como carroñero.

name: Krokorok
description_en: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
description_es: Krokorok entierra parte de sus presas en la arena para comerlas cuando no consigue cazar.

name: Krookodile
description_en: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.
description_es: Krookodile se oculta en tormentas de arena levantadas por Flygon para emboscar a sus víctimas.

name: Darumaka
description_en: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es: Al dormir, Darumaka recoge las extremidades y reduce la intensidad de su fuego interior.

name: Darmanitan
description_en: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
description_es: Darmanitan alberga un fuego ardiente que le permite destrozar camiones de un puñetazo.

name: Maractus
description_en: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
description_es: Maractus habita desiertos y se mueve rítmicamente produciendo sonidos parecidos a maracas.

name: Dwebble
description_en: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
description_es: Dwebble agujerea piedras usando un líquido de su boca para convertirlas en refugios.

name: Crustle
description_en: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
description_es: Crustle pelea por territorio; pierde el combate quien termina con la roca rota.

name: Scraggy
description_en: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more respect they garner.
description_es: Scraggy se sube la piel suelta hasta el cuello para protegerse y presumir ante otros.

name: Scrafty
description_en: It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.
description_es: Scrafty provoca a sus rivales escupiendo y pasa toda su vida dentro del mismo territorio.

name: Sigilyph
description_en: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
description_es: Sigilyph protegía antiguas ciudades y siempre vuela por las mismas rutas vigilando intrusos.

name: Yamask
description_en: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
description_es: Yamask porta una máscara con el rostro que tuvo cuando era humano y a veces llora.

name: Cofagrigus
description_en: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
description_es: Cofagrigus atrapa dentro de su cuerpo a ladrones de tumbas que lo confunden con un ataúd.

name: Tirtouga
description_en: Its hunting grounds encompassed a broad area, from the land to more than half a mile deep in the ocean.
description_es: Tirtouga cazaba tanto en tierra firme como en grandes profundidades marinas.

name: Carracosta
description_en: Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it catches, even the shells and bones, to further strengthen its sturdy shell.
description_es: Carracosta se come a sus presas por completo, incluidos huesos y conchas, para fortalecer su caparazón.

name: Archen
description_en: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.
description_es: Archen fue restaurado a partir de un fósil; tiene alas, pero todavía no puede volar.

name: Archeops
description_en: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.
description_es: Archeops es un antepasado de los Pokémon pájaro y necesita tomar carrera para despegar.

name: Trubbish
description_en: If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.
description_es: El gas venenoso que expulsa Trubbish puede resultar mortal para niños y Pokémon jóvenes.

name: Garbodor
description_en: Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.
description_es: Garbodor de Alola parece más fuerte por la presencia de Muk, su enemigo natural.

name: Zorua
description_en: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.
description_es: Zorua puede sustituir a un niño imitando su apariencia, aunque quizá deje de hablar.

name: Zoroark
description_en: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.
description_es: Zoroark crea ilusiones de bosques interminables para alejar a personas de su madriguera.

name: Minccino
description_en: When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean spring water.
description_es: Minccino pasa mucho tiempo lavando su cola cuando se ensucia al limpiar su cuerpo o nido.

name: Cinccino
description_en: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.
description_es: El aceite corporal de Cinccino es muy suave y puede utilizarse para cuidar la piel.

name: Gothita
description_en: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.
description_es: Gothita observa atentamente a personas y Pokémon, quizá porque ve cosas invisibles para los demás.

name: Gothorita
description_en: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.
description_es: Algunos relatos dicen que Gothorita controla a niños dormidos para convertirlos en sus amigos.

name: Gothitelle
description_en: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.
description_es: Gothitelle estudia las estrellas para predecir el futuro e incluso la esperanza de vida de entrenadores.

name: Solosis
description_en: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
description_es: Solosis ahuyenta ataques con poderes psíquicos y se comunica mediante telepatía.

name: Duosion
description_en: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.
description_es: Duosion aumenta enormemente su poder psíquico cuando sus dos cerebros piensan lo mismo.

name: Reuniclus
description_en: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
description_es: Reuniclus conecta sus cerebros al estrechar las manos con otros y aumenta sus poderes psíquicos.

name: Ducklett
description_en: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
description_es: Ducklett nada mejor que vuela y come musgo mientras bucea alegremente.

name: Swanna
description_en: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
description_es: Swanna baila al atardecer y el ejemplar del centro dirige la bandada.

name: Vanillite
description_en: When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it buries itself in snow to sleep.
description_es: Vanillite nació, según dicen, de un carámbano que deseó no derretirse; duerme bajo la nieve.

name: Vanillish
description_en: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot regions.
description_es: Vanillish sobrevivió a la era glacial y ahora es popular en regiones muy calurosas.

name: Vanilluxe
description_en: Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day’s light, stick to each other and freeze together in the cold return of night.
description_es: Vanilluxe se forma cuando dos Vanillish medio derretidos se unen y vuelven a congelarse.

name: Deerling
description_en: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
description_es: El pelaje de Deerling cambia de color y olor con las estaciones y permite reconocerlas.

name: Sawsbuck
description_en: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
description_es: Sawsbuck migra con las estaciones y es considerado un anuncio de la primavera.

name: Emolga
description_en: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That’s why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.
description_es: Emolga desprende electricidad al planear, ahuyenta aves y así conserva su comida.

name: Karrablast
description_en: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
description_es: Karrablast evoluciona al recibir energía eléctrica mientras ataca a Shelmet.

name: Escavalier
description_en: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
description_es: Escavalier utiliza el caparazón de Shelmet como armadura de acero y protección completa.

name: Foongus
description_en: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.
description_es: Foongus atrae a otros Pokémon con dibujos parecidos a una Poké Ball y libera esporas.

name: Amoonguss
description_en: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
