description_es: Amoonguss baila moviendo sus brazos con forma de Poké Ball para atraer presas.

name: Frillish
description_en: Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and causes them to drown.
description_es: Frillish inmoviliza con púas venenosas invisibles y arrastra a sus enemigos al agua.

name: Jellicent
description_en: Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent. It’s rumored to drag them into the sea and steal their lives away.
description_es: Los pescadores temen a Jellicent porque, según rumores, arrastra a personas hacia el mar.

name: Alomomola
description_en: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
description_es: Alomomola ayuda a Pokémon heridos para evitar que otros depredadores también lo ataquen.

name: Joltik
description_en: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.
description_es: Joltik se fija a Pokémon grandes y absorbe electricidad estática para guardarla en su cuerpo.

name: Galvantula
description_en: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
description_es: Galvantula forma barreras eléctricas disparando numerosos hilos cargados cuando recibe ataques.

name: Ferroseed
description_en: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.
description_es: Ferroseed absorbe hierro de las rocas en cuevas y dispara espinas para defenderse.

name: Ferrothorn
description_en: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.
description_es: Ferrothorn se aferra a techos de cuevas y lanza púas metálicas a quienes pasan debajo.

name: Klink
description_en: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
description_es: Los dos engranajes pequeños de Klink solo encajan entre sí y no con otros.

name: Klang
description_en: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.
description_es: Klang lanza un engranaje contra los enemigos, pero puede morir si no regresa.

name: Klinklang
description_en: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
description_es: El núcleo rojo de Klinklang guarda energía que dispara por sus púas.

name: Tynamo
description_en: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
description_es: Tynamo produce poca electricidad individualmente, pero juntos forman descargas mucho más fuertes.

name: Eelektrik
description_en: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
description_es: Eelektrik tiene gran apetito y paraliza con electricidad a las presas que encuentra.

name: Eelektross
description_en: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
description_es: Eelektross sale del mar apoyándose en los brazos y arrastra a sus víctimas al agua.

name: Elgyem
description_en: This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. It’s said to have appeared from a UFO that fell from the sky about 50 years ago.
description_es: Elgyem está rodeado de misterio y se dice que llegó en un ovni hace décadas.

name: Beheeyem
description_en: It has strong psychic powers. Using its fingers that flash three different colors, it controls its opponents and rewrites their memories.
description_es: Beheeyem controla adversarios y altera recuerdos con los destellos de sus dedos de colores.

name: Litwick
description_en: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
description_es: La llama de Litwick consume energía vital de personas y Pokémon para mantenerse encendida.

name: Lampent
description_en: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.
description_es: Lampent aparece cerca de seres agonizantes y les roba su energía espiritual.

name: Chandelure
description_en: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.
description_es: Las llamas de Chandelure queman espíritus, condenándolos a vagar eternamente.

name: Axew
description_en: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.
description_es: Axew marca su territorio hiriendo árboles con los colmillos, que vuelven a crecer si se rompen.

name: Fraxure
description_en: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.
description_es: Fraxure afila sus colmillos en las rocas porque, si se parten, no vuelven a crecer.

name: Haxorus
description_en: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.
description_es: Haxorus tiene colmillos resistentes capaces de cortar acero y un cuerpo protegido por armadura.

name: Cubchoo
description_en: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.
description_es: El moco de Cubchoo revela su salud; cuando está fuerte, potencia sus movimientos de hielo.

name: Beartic
description_en: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
description_es: Beartic congela el aliento para formar colmillos y garras de hielo con que combatir.

name: Cryogonal
description_en: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es: Cryogonal está hecho de cristales de hielo y captura presas con cadenas heladas.

name: Shelmet
description_en: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.
description_es: Shelmet evoluciona al recibir una energía extraña junto a Karrablast; el motivo es desconocido.

name: Accelgor
description_en: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
description_es: Accelgor se envuelve en capas de membrana fina para evitar deshidratarse y debilitarse.

name: Stunfisk
description_en: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
description_es: Stunfisk se oculta en barro costero y descarga electricidad cuando alguna presa lo toca.

name: Mienfoo
description_en: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.
description_es: Mienfoo entrena aislado en las montañas y cada grupo desarrolla sus propias patadas y golpes.

name: Mienshao
description_en: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you’re in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!
description_es: El extraño grito de Mienshao anuncia una ráfaga de patadas y golpes demasiado rápidos para verse.

name: Druddigon
description_en: It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey to pass through.
description_es: Druddigon espera en túneles excavados por otros Pokémon hasta que pasen sus presas.

name: Golett
description_en: Although ancient people apparently built it by working with clay, the source of its energy is unclear.
description_es: Golett fue moldeado en arcilla por pueblos antiguos, pero se desconoce su fuente de energía.

name: Golurk
description_en: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.
description_es: Golurk arrasa todo a su paso cuando se retira el sello que lleva en el pecho.

name: Pawniard
description_en: It follows Bisharp’s orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.
description_es: Pawniard obedece a Bisharp durante sus ataques y choca sus cuchillas tras derrotar al rival.

name: Bisharp
description_en: It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn’t even change its expression when it deals the finishing blow to an opponent.
description_es: Bisharp dirige grupos de Pawniard y remata a sus enemigos sin cambiar de expresión.

name: Bouffalant
description_en: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
description_es: El pelaje esponjoso de Bouffalant amortigua el daño cuando embiste con fuerza.

name: Rufflet
description_en: Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in order to gain their acceptance.
description_es: Rufflet es un guerrero nato y reta a sus padres poco después de nacer.

name: Braviary
description_en: Known as “the hero of the skies,” this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it’s injured.
description_es: Braviary es conocido como héroe de los cielos y nunca retrocede aunque esté herido.

name: Vullaby
description_en: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
description_es: Vullaby crece rápidamente y debe cambiar a menudo los huesos que utiliza como protección.

name: Mandibuzz
description_en: It’s always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.
description_es: Mandibuzz busca comida para Vullaby y transporta Pokémon débiles hasta su nido.

name: Heatmor
description_en: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
description_es: Heatmor absorbe aire por la cola, lo convierte en fuego y lo usa para derretir Durant.

name: Durant
description_en: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
description_es: Los Durant se defienden en grupo y usan su armadura metálica contra Heatmor.

name: Deino
description_en: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
description_es: Deino no puede ver, choca con objetos y muerde cualquier cosa que se mueva.

name: Zweilous
description_en: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
description_es: Las dos cabezas de Zweilous no se llevan bien; cambia de zona cuando agota su alimento.

name: Hydreigon
description_en: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
description_es: Hydreigon ataca cualquier movimiento y devora todo lo que encuentra con sus tres cabezas.

name: Larvesta
description_en: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
description_es: Larvesta se protege con fuego y antiguamente se creía que vivía en el Sol.

name: Volcarona
description_en: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.
description_es: La leyenda cuenta que Volcarona nació de un capullo ardiente para salvar seres del frío.

name: Cobalion
description_en: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
description_es: Cobalion tiene cuerpo y corazón de acero y defendió a los Pokémon frente a humanos crueles.

name: Terrakion
description_en: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.
description_es: Terrakion destruyó un castillo, según la leyenda, para proteger a otros Pokémon.

name: Virizion
description_en: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
description_es: Virizion desconcierta a sus adversarios con movimientos extraordinariamente rápidos.

name: Tornadus
description_en: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
description_es: Tornadus libera energía desde su cola y provoca tormentas capaces de derribar casas.

name: Thundurus
description_en: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.
description_es: Thundurus dispara rayos al volar y puede causar incendios forestales.

name: Reshiram
description_en: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.
description_es: El calor de la cola de Reshiram altera la atmósfera y cambia el clima del planeta.

name: Zekrom
description_en: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
description_es: Zekrom vuela entre nubes de tormenta y genera electricidad en su cola.

name: Landorus
description_en: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.
description_es: Landorus transforma la energía del viento y los rayos en nutrientes para enriquecer la tierra.

name: Kyurem
description_en: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
description_es: Kyurem genera una energía congelante tan potente que termina helando su propio cuerpo.

name: Keldeo
description_en: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
description_es: Keldeo alcanza una velocidad excepcional cuando está decidido y cargado de poder.

name: Meloetta
description_en: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
description_es: Meloetta canta melodías especiales capaces de influir en las emociones de quienes la escuchan.

name: Genesect
description_en: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
description_es: Genesect vivió hace millones de años y fue modificado por el Equipo Plasma con un cañón.

name: Chespin
description_en: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.
description_es: Chespin posee una coraza de madera tan resistente que ni un camión puede hacerle daño.

name: Quilladin
description_en: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.
description_es: Quilladin fortalece sus patas chocando contra otros; es amable y no suele iniciar peleas.

name: Chesnaught
description_en: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
description_es: Chesnaught puede resistir una explosión poderosa cuando se protege el rostro con los puños.

name: Fennekin
description_en: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.
description_es: Fennekin mastica ramitas mientras camina y ahuyenta adversarios expulsando aire caliente por las orejas.

name: Braixen
description_en: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
description_es: Braixen enciende una ramita usando la fricción y utiliza su llama para comunicarse.

name: Delphox
description_en: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.
description_es: Delphox crea con poderes psíquicos remolinos de fuego capaces de calcinar a sus enemigos.

name: Froakie
description_en: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
description_es: Froakie protege su piel con burbujas delicadas y vigila el entorno aunque parezca despreocupado.

name: Frogadier
description_en: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
description_es: Frogadier es extremadamente ágil y puede escalar una torre altísima en apenas un minuto.

name: Greninja
description_en: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
description_es: Greninja aparece y desaparece como un ninja y ataca con estrellas cortantes de agua.

name: Bunnelby
description_en: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
description_es: Bunnelby usa sus orejas como palas y las fortalece excavando hasta cortar raíces gruesas.

name: Diggersby
description_en: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it’s finished digging, it lounges lazily.
description_es: Diggersby tiene orejas tan poderosas como una excavadora y descansa después de cavar.

name: Fletchling
description_en: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.
description_es: El cuerpo de Fletchling es cálido y algunos entrenadores duermen con él en regiones frías.

name: Fletchinder
description_en: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.
description_es: Fletchinder alcanza velocidades extraordinarias apenas despega del suelo.

name: Talonflame
description_en: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.
description_es: Talonflame caza Pokémon pájaro lanzándose a gran velocidad y golpeándolos con patadas.

name: Scatterbug
description_en: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
description_es: El polvo del cuerpo de Scatterbug regula su temperatura y le permite vivir en casi cualquier clima.

name: Spewpa
description_en: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
description_es: Spewpa tiene un cuerpo resistente a los picotazos y se defiende liberando polvo.

name: Vivillon
description_en: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.
description_es: Los dibujos de las alas de Vivillon dependen del clima y del paisaje donde vive.

name: Litleo
description_en: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.
description_es: Litleo es curioso y temperamental; su pequeña melena se calienta cuando se enfada.

name: Pyroar
description_en: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.
description_es: Pyroar tiene un aliento extremadamente caliente, pero prefiere comer carne cruda.

name: Flabébé
description_en: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
description_es: Flabébé lleva una corona hecha con polen de flores que posee propiedades curativas.

name: Floette
description_en: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
description_es: Floette cuida las flores con dedicación y no perdona a quienes destrozan sus jardines.

name: Florges
description_en: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
description_es: Florges vive durante siglos y dedica su vida a proteger jardines.

name: Skiddo
description_en: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
description_es: Skiddo produce energía con las hojas de la espalda si dispone de sol y agua.

name: Gogoat
description_en: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
description_es: Gogoat vive en montañas y los líderes de sus manadas se eligen por combates de cuernos.

name: Pancham
description_en: It’s desperate to intimidate its opponents. Be nice and pretend to be scared if you catch it glaring at you intensely.
description_es: Pancham intenta parecer amenazante; conviene fingir miedo cuando te mira con intensidad.

name: Pangoro
description_en: Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It doesn’t say much as it pummels opponents with enough force to send a dump truck flying.
description_es: Pangoro habla con los puños y puede golpear con fuerza suficiente para desplazar un camión.

name: Furfrou
description_en: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
description_es: Furfrou deja crecer su pelaje indefinidamente y solo permite cortarlo a personas de confianza.

name: Espurr
description_en: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.
description_es: Espurr tiene una energía psíquica enorme, pero todavía no puede controlarla.

name: Meowstic
description_en: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.
description_es: Meowstic oculta en las orejas dibujos que emiten un poder psíquico demasiado intenso.

name: Honedge
description_en: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.
description_es: Honedge envuelve con una tela el brazo de quien agarra su empuñadura y absorbe su energía vital.

name: Doublade
description_en: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
description_es: Los dos sables de Doublade ejecutan ataques complejos que incluso espadachines expertos difícilmente detienen.

name: Aegislash
description_en: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
description_es: Aegislash detecta cualidades de liderazgo y, según la leyenda, elige a futuros reyes.

name: Spritzee
description_en: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.
description_es: Antiguamente las damas de la realeza llevaban Spritzee para disfrutar de sus fragancias favoritas.

name: Aromatisse
description_en: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.
description_es: El aroma de Aromatisse es tan fuerte que resulta difícil acompañarlo si no te gusta.

name: Swirlix
description_en: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.
description_es: Swirlix solo come dulces y su pelaje es pegajoso como el algodón de azúcar.

name: Slurpuff
description_en: Its sense of smell is 100 million times better than a human’s, so even the faintest scent tells it about everything in the area. It’s like it can see with its nose!
description_es: Slurpuff posee un olfato extraordinario y percibe su entorno casi como si pudiera verlo.

name: Inkay
description_en: When exchanging information with others of its kind, it flashes the light-emitting spots on its body in a complex rhythm.
description_es: Inkay intercambia información haciendo parpadear con ritmos complejos las luces de su cuerpo.

name: Malamar
description_en: It flashes the pattern on its torso to control its prey and draw them in. The edges of its fins are supremely sharp.
description_es: Malamar hipnotiza a sus presas con patrones luminosos y las atrapa con aletas afiladas.

name: Binacle
description_en: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.
description_es: Binacle mueve las rocas en las que vive estirándose y contrayéndose, y come algas costeras.

name: Barbaracle
description_en: Barbaracle’s legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head’s orders.
description_es: Las piernas y manos de Barbaracle parecen tener voluntad propia, aunque obedecen a su cabeza.

name: Skrelp
description_en: It’s not good at swimming, so it clings to the seaweed. In the Alola region, it’s often found near Dhelmise.
description_es: Skrelp nada mal y se agarra a algas para ocultarse entre ellas.

name: Dragalge
description_en: It blends in with seaweed to ambush its prey and then takes them down with a poisonous liquid strong enough to melt metal.
description_es: Dragalge embosca a sus presas entre las algas y lanza veneno capaz de derretir metal.

name: Clauncher
description_en: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it’s terrible at swimming straight.
description_es: Clauncher se impulsa disparando agua de la pinza derecha, pero le cuesta nadar en línea recta.

name: Clawitzer
description_en: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it’s exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.
description_es: La pinza carnosa de Clawitzer puede desprenderse y utilizarse como alimento.

name: Helioptile
description_en: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.
description_es: Las membranas laterales de Helioptile generan electricidad al recibir luz solar.

name: Heliolisk
description_en: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.
description_es: Heliolisk estimula sus piernas con electricidad para correr a velocidades extraordinarias.

name: Tyrunt
description_en: Tyrunt is spoiled and selfish. It may just be trying to frolic, but sometimes the ones it’s trying to frolic with are gravely injured.
description_es: Tyrunt es mimado y egoísta; incluso cuando juega puede causar heridas graves.

name: Tyrantrum
description_en: The king of the ancient world, it can easily crunch a car with the devastating strength of its enormous jaws.
description_es: Tyrantrum dominaba el mundo antiguo y podía triturar automóviles con sus mandíbulas.

name: Amaura
description_en: Amaura was restored successfully, but it’s not expected to live long because of the heat of the current environment.
description_es: Amaura fue revivido de un fósil, pero el calor actual dificulta su supervivencia.

name: Aurorus
description_en: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around –240 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es: Aurorus suele ser tranquilo y amable, aunque su cuerpo está extremadamente frío.

name: Sylveon
description_en: Sylveon wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its Trainer’s arm because this touch enables it to read its Trainer’s feelings.
description_es: Sylveon rodea el brazo de su entrenador con cintas para percibir sus sentimientos.

name: Hawlucha
description_en: In combat, Hawlucha leaps nimbly about, taking advantage of its opponents’ blind spots. It’s also skilled at using superb submission holds.
description_es: Hawlucha aprovecha puntos ciegos al luchar y domina espectaculares llaves de combate.

name: Dedenne
description_en: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.
description_es: Los bigotes superiores de Dedenne detectan el entorno y los inferiores descargan electricidad.

name: Carbink
description_en: To keep the jewels on their bodies free of tarnish, packs of Carbink use their soft manes to polish one another’s jewels.
description_es: Los Carbink se pulen mutuamente sus joyas con sus suaves melenas para mantenerlas brillantes.

name: Goomy
description_en: Its body is mostly water. If it dries out, it will die, so it’s always sitting with perfect stillness in the shade.
description_es: El cuerpo de Goomy es casi todo agua; si se reseca, puede morir.

name: Sliggoo
description_en: Its entire body is covered with gooey mucus that can dissolve anything. Be sure to put gloves on if you’re going to touch it.
description_es: Sliggoo está cubierto de una mucosidad que disuelve sustancias y hace peligroso tocarlo.

name: Goodra
description_en: Underneath its slimy skin is a thick layer of fat, and the combination of the two makes enemies’ attacks slide right off.
description_es: Goodra tiene piel viscosa y grasa protectora que hacen resbalar los ataques enemigos.

name: Klefki
description_en: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.
description_es: Klefki comenzó a acercarse a poblados humanos cuando escasearon los minerales que comía.

name: Phantump
description_en: An unknown spirit came to lodge in a tree stump, creating this Pokémon. A cure-all can be made from an infusion of its green leaves.
description_es: Phantump nació cuando un espíritu se instaló en un tocón de árbol; sus hojas se usan medicinalmente.

name: Trevenant
description_en: This Pokémon controls trees via roots stretching from its feet, and it will attack anyone that dares to ravage the forest.
description_es: Trevenant controla árboles mediante sus raíces y ataca a quienes dañan el bosque.

name: Pumpkaboo
description_en: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.
description_es: Pumpkaboo guía a los espíritus errantes hacia el lugar donde pueden descansar.

name: Gourgeist
description_en: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.
description_es: Gourgeist envuelve a sus presas con brazos parecidos a cabellos y canta mientras las observa sufrir.

name: Bergmite
description_en: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.
description_es: Bergmite habita zonas nevadas y congela a sus enemigos con aire extremadamente frío.

name: Avalugg
description_en: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.
description_es: Avalugg parece un portaaviones de hielo cuando varios Bergmite se reúnen sobre su espalda.

name: Noibat
description_en: It flies around in search of fruit to eat. It uses ultrasonic waves to detect which fruits are ripe.
description_es: Noibat busca frutas maduras utilizando ondas ultrasónicas para comprobar cuáles puede comer.

name: Noivern
description_en: This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks anything it sees with ultrasonic waves that can crush boulders.
description_es: Noivern ataca con ondas ultrasónicas tan fuertes que pueden romper grandes piedras.

name: Xerneas
description_en: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
description_es: Cuando los cuernos de Xerneas brillan en siete colores, se dice que comparte vida eterna.

name: Yveltal
description_en: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
description_es: Yveltal absorbe energía vital al morir y vuelve a convertirse en un capullo.

name: Zygarde
description_en: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
description_es: Zygarde puede adoptar formas más poderosas al enfrentarse a amenazas contra el ecosistema.

name: Diancie
description_en: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
description_es: Diancie comprime el carbono del aire entre sus manos para fabricar diamantes al instante.

name: Hoopa
description_en: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.
description_es: Hoopa puede conseguir lo que desea con sus anillos y enormes brazos; sellado, se vuelve pequeño.

name: Volcanion
description_en: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
description_es: Volcanion expulsa vapor por los brazos y tiene fuerza suficiente para destruir una montaña.

name: Rowlet
description_en: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer’s pocket or bag as a nest.
description_es: Rowlet se siente seguro en espacios oscuros y pequeños, como el bolsillo de su entrenador.

name: Dartrix
description_en: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.
description_es: Dartrix detecta enemigos incluso detrás de sí y les dispara plumas afiladas.

name: Decidueye
description_en: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.
description_es: Decidueye dispara flechas con tal rapidez que puede decidir una batalla en una décima de segundo.

name: Litten
description_en: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.
description_es: Litten renueva su pelaje dos veces al año y quema el pelo viejo con sus propias llamas.

name: Torracat
description_en: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it’s feeling good. When it isn’t feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.
description_es: Torracat revela su ánimo con la posición de la melena: erizada al estar contento.

name: Incineroar
description_en: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
description_es: Las llamas de la cintura de Incineroar aumentan cuando se enciende su espíritu de lucha.

name: Popplio
description_en: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It’s quite the acrobatic fighter!
description_es: Popplio realiza acrobacias saltando sobre globos de agua que él mismo fabrica.

name: Brionne
description_en: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.
description_es: Brionne golpea a sus enemigos con globos de agua que explotan al impactar.

name: Primarina
description_en: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.
description_es: Primarina tiene una voz magnífica y dirige cantos grupales durante las noches de luna.

name: Pikipek
description_en: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
description_es: Pikipek tiene músculos del cuello muy fuertes y puede picotear árboles muchas veces por segundo.

name: Trumbeak
description_en: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
description_es: Trumbeak escupe semillas de bayas y ayuda así a que crezcan nuevas plantas.

name: Toucannon
description_en: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
description_es: Toucannon forma parejas armoniosas y se considera un símbolo de buena suerte en bodas.

name: Yungoos
description_en: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
description_es: Yungoos come casi cualquier cosa y recorre calles buscando presas frescas.

name: Gumshoos
description_en: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
description_es: Gumshoos es paciente, pero pierde el control cuando ve un Rattata para comer.

name: Grubbin
description_en: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.
description_es: Grubbin inmoviliza enemigos con hilos pegajosos y después los ataca con sus mandíbulas.

name: Charjabug
description_en: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.
description_es: El caparazón de Charjabug ofrece gran protección y descarga electricidad sobre rivales insistentes.

name: Vikavolt
description_en: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.
description_es: Vikavolt esquiva con acrobacias aéreas y aprovecha los descuidos para disparar rayos eléctricos.

name: Crabrawler
description_en: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
description_es: Crabrawler a veces confunde a Exeggutor con una palmera y termina recibiendo un golpe.

name: Crabominable
description_en: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
description_es: Crabominable golpea antes de pensar y se conocen casos en que detuvo avalanchas a puñetazos.

name: Oricorio
description_en: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
description_es: Oricorio cambia según el néctar que toma; esta forma roja se enfada ante órdenes equivocadas.

name: Cutiefly
description_en: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes’ movements and make fools of them.
description_es: Cutiefly percibe auras de seres vivos y anticipa los movimientos de sus oponentes.

name: Ribombee
description_en: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.
description_es: Ribombee predice el tiempo observando humedad y viento, y sale cuando vienen días despejados.

name: Rockruff
description_en: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that’s proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
description_es: Rockruff demuestra cariño frotando las piedras afiladas de su cuello contra su entrenador.

name: Lycanroc
description_en: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
description_es: Las piedras de la melena de Lycanroc son muy afiladas y se guardan como amuletos.

name: Wishiwashi
description_en: When it’s in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
description_es: Wishiwashi atrae a sus compañeros con el brillo de sus ojos cuando está en peligro.

name: Mareanie
description_en: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they’re cut off. After a good night’s sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.
description_es: Mareanie regenera rápidamente casi todas las partes de su cuerpo después de descansar.

name: Toxapex
description_en: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn’t affect Toxapex in there, so it’s very comfortable.
description_es: Toxapex forma con sus doce patas una cúpula donde se refugia de las mareas.

name: Mudbray
description_en: Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.
description_es: Mudbray es muy fuerte y puede transportar cargas mucho más pesadas que su propio cuerpo.

name: Mudsdale
description_en: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.
description_es: Mudsdale es capaz de caminar varios días cargando pesos enormes sin descansar.

name: Dewpider
description_en: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.
description_es: Dewpider solo respira oxígeno disuelto en agua y lleva una burbuja sobre la cabeza.

name: Araquanid
description_en: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn’t watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
description_es: Araquanid guarda objetos apreciados en su burbuja de agua, incluso intenta guardar a su entrenador.

name: Fomantis
description_en: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.
description_es: Fomantis adora el sol y desarrolla colores brillantes si recibe suficiente luz.

name: Lurantis
description_en: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it’s dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.
description_es: Lurantis parece bailar cuando lucha y destaca por su elegante apariencia entre los Pokémon Planta.

name: Morelull
description_en: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.
description_es: Morelull vive en lugares húmedos y oscuros; las esporas de sus hongos brillan por la noche.

name: Shiinotic
description_en: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
description_es: Shiinotic puede cubrir todo un territorio de esporas cuando lucha contra Parasect.

name: Salandit
description_en: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn’t deal well with Spinda, since it’s always reeling.
description_es: Salandit debilita rivales con gas venenoso, aunque le cuesta enfrentarse al imprevisible Spinda.

name: Salazzle
description_en: It punishes Salandit that couldn’t bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
description_es: Salazzle castiga con llamas a los Salandit que no consiguen llevarle comida.

name: Stufful
description_en: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
description_es: Stufful detesta los abrazos y se retuerce con una fuerza sorprendente cuando lo tocan.

name: Bewear
description_en: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.
description_es: Bewear es extremadamente fuerte y muchos lo consideran el Pokémon más peligroso de Alola.

name: Bounsweet
description_en: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It’s usually a fruitless attempt.
description_es: Bounsweet gira las hojas de su cabeza para escapar de aves, casi siempre sin éxito.

name: Steenee
description_en: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They’re quite painful when they smack you!
description_es: Steenee se mueve dando saltos y golpea con fuerza usando las hojas de su cabeza.

name: Tsareena
description_en: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.
description_es: Tsareena tiene un carácter agresivo y disfruta utilizando patadas poderosas contra sus enemigos.

name: Comfey
description_en: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.
description_es: Comfey recoge flores, las adhiere a su cuerpo y desprende un aroma con propiedades curativas.

name: Oranguru
description_en: Oranguru don’t get along with each other, so they’re always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.
description_es: Los Oranguru compiten entre sí mediante duelos de inteligencia para demostrar quién es superior.

name: Passimian
description_en: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.
description_es: Passimian se alimenta de bayas y las utiliza como armas; el líder es quien las lanza más lejos.

name: Wimpod
description_en: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.
description_es: Wimpod es extremadamente cobarde y huye moviendo las patas a toda velocidad ante cualquier acercamiento.

name: Golisopod
description_en: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.
description_es: Golisopod usa como armas principales sus garras retráctiles y a veces va acompañado de Wimpod.

name: Sandygast
description_en: If you build sand mounds when you’re playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.
description_es: Los montones de arena abandonados después de jugar podrían quedar poseídos y convertirse en Sandygast.

name: Palossand
description_en: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.
description_es: Palossand provoca tormentas de arena para inmovilizar a sus oponentes y robarles la energía vital.

name: Pyukumuku
description_en: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you’ll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!
description_es: Pyukumuku está cubierto de mucosidad; si lo pisas y resbalas, puede enfadarse y golpearte.

name: Type: Null
description_en: There’s danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
description_es: El verdadero poder de Type: Null permanece sellado bajo una máscara para evitar que se descontrole.

name: Silvally
description_en: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
description_es: Silvally destruyó su máscara de control gracias a la fuerza de voluntad nacida de su vínculo con su entrenador.

name: Minior
description_en: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
description_es: El caparazón exterior de Minior es resistente, pero se rompe al chocar contra el suelo.

name: Komala
description_en: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
description_es: Komala duerme toda su vida por los efectos sedantes de las hojas con que se alimenta.

name: Turtonator
description_en: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.
description_es: El caparazón explosivo de Turtonator es peligroso, pero sensible a la humedad; se refugia cuando llueve.

name: Togedemaru
description_en: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!
description_es: Togedemaru produce poca electricidad por sí mismo y se recarga dejando que le caigan rayos.

name: Mimikyu
description_en: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon’s rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
description_es: Un entrenador vio accidentalmente lo oculto bajo el disfraz de Mimikyu y murió aquella noche, según cuentan.

name: Bruxish
description_en: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
description_es: La piel de Bruxish resiste las púas de Mareanie y sus dientes fuertes permiten triturarlas.

name: Drampa
description_en: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they’re in danger, so their moms don’t have to worry.
description_es: Drampa visita pueblos para jugar con niños y los protege cuando están en peligro.

name: Dhelmise
description_en: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.
description_es: Las algas de Dhelmise pueden extenderse cientos de metros y se lleva bien con Skrelp.

name: Jangmo-o
description_en: It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.
description_es: Jangmo-o nunca da la espalda al enemigo; antiguamente los guerreros admiraban su valentía.

name: Hakamo-o
description_en: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they’re a popular item.
description_es: Las escamas que pierde Hakamo-o se utilizan para fabricar ollas y sartenes porque conducen bien el calor.

name: Kommo-o
description_en: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
description_es: Kommo-o lucha valientemente con los puños cubiertos de escamas de acero y domina los ganchos ascendentes.

name: Tapu Koko
description_en: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
description_es: Tapu Koko es el guardián eléctrico de Melemele; su curiosidad lo lleva a aparecer ante las personas.

name: Tapu Lele
description_en: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
description_es: Aunque es una deidad guardiana, Tapu Lele puede ser cruel y actuar sin remordimientos.

name: Tapu Bulu
description_en: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.
description_es: Tapu Bulu controla las plantas de Ula'ula y hace sonar su cola para evitar conflictos innecesarios.

name: Tapu Fini
description_en: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
description_es: Tapu Fini es una deidad guardiana, pero acercarse a él sin cuidado puede atraer desgracias.

name: Cosmog
description_en: Whether or not it’s a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it’s in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.
description_es: Se desconoce si Cosmog procede de este mundo; cuando peligra, se teletransporta a un refugio.

name: Cosmoem
description_en: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
description_es: Cosmoem crece absorbiendo luz y tiene una coraza dorada sorprendentemente resistente.

name: Solgaleo
description_en: In writings from the distant past, it’s called by the name “the beast that devours the sun.”
description_es: Los textos antiguos llaman a Solgaleo «la bestia que devora el sol».

name: Lunala
description_en: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
description_es: Lunala puede invocar poderes y seres desconocidos a través de portales hacia otros mundos.

name: Nihilego
description_en: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
description_es: Nihilego llegó mediante un Ultraumbral y parece ser un parásito de personas y Pokémon.

name: Buzzwole
description_en: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
description_es: Buzzwole es un Ultraente que exhibe constantemente sus músculos desmesurados.

name: Pheromosa
description_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description_es: Pheromosa es peligroso aquí, aunque parece ser un organismo común en su mundo de origen.

name: Xurkitree
description_en: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
description_es: Xurkitree es un Ultraente que puede quedarse inmóvil como un árbol, clavando extremidades en el suelo.

name: Celesteela
description_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description_es: Celesteela es peligroso en nuestro mundo, pero parece ser una especie habitual donde vive normalmente.

name: Kartana
description_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description_es: Kartana es peligroso en nuestro mundo, aunque resulta común en su dimensión de origen.

name: Guzzlord
description_en: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
description_es: Guzzlord es un Ultraente de origen desconocido que parece tener hambre sin parar y devora todo.

name: Necrozma
description_en: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn’t devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
description_es: Necrozma necesita absorber luz; sin ella, acumula impurezas, se oscurece y deja de moverse.

name: Magearna
description_en: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
description_es: Magearna fue construido hace unos quinientos años; su verdadero ser está en el Corazón Ánima.

name: Marshadow
description_en: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.
description_es: Marshadow se oculta en sombras ajenas para comprender sentimientos y copiar habilidades.

name: Poipole
description_en: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
description_es: Poipole es un Ultraente de otro mundo que ríe mientras lanza veneno desde las agujas de su cabeza.

name: Naganadel
description_en: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
description_es: Naganadel dispara desde sus agujas un líquido venenoso, brillante y extremadamente pegajoso.

name: Stakataka
description_en: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
description_es: Stakataka es un ser misterioso semejante a un Ultraente, formado por muros que cobran vida y atacan.

name: Blacephalon
description_en: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
description_es: Blacephalon surge de un Ultraumbral, provoca explosiones y aprovecha la sorpresa para robar energía vital.

name: Zeraora
description_en: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
description_es: Zeraora se aproxima a la velocidad del rayo y desgarra enemigos con sus garras afiladas.

name: Meltan
description_en: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
description_es: Los Meltan viven en grupos; llegado el momento, uno fuerte absorbe a los demás y evoluciona.

name: Melmetal
description_en: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
description_es: Melmetal golpea con sus pesados brazos de tuercas mediante fuerza centrífuga y tiene puñetazos formidables.

name: Grookey
description_en: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
description_es: Grookey golpea rápidamente con su palo y se entusiasma cada vez más con el ritmo.

name: Thwackey
description_en: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.
description_es: Thwackey se deja llevar tanto por el ritmo de sus golpes que no nota cuando ya venció.

name: Rillaboom
description_en: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
description_es: Rillaboom lidera según su habilidad con la percusión; tiene carácter pacífico y valora la armonía.

name: Scorbunny
description_en: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
description_es: Scorbunny tiene almohadillas en patas y nariz que desprenden mucho calor cuando quiere luchar.

name: Raboot
description_en: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
description_es: Raboot derriba bayas de los árboles de una patada y las mantiene en el aire para practicar.

name: Cinderace
description_en: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
description_es: Cinderace domina el ataque y la defensa, pero lucirse demasiado puede ponerlo en dificultades.

name: Sobble
description_en: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
description_es: La piel de Sobble cambia de color al mojarse y lo vuelve prácticamente invisible.

name: Drizzile
description_en: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
description_es: Drizzile es inteligente pero perezoso y defiende su territorio colocando trampas.

name: Inteleon
description_en: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
description_es: Inteleon detecta los puntos débiles de enemigos y dispara agua con precisión desde los dedos.

name: Skwovet
description_en: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.
description_es: Skwovet come bayas continuamente y visita granjas para encontrar todavía más alimento.

name: Greedent
description_en: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
description_es: Greedent es común en Galar y sus dientes rompen incluso las cáscaras más duras de bayas.

name: Rookidee
description_en: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
description_es: Rookidee salta ágilmente y aprovecha cualquier oportunidad para confundir a enemigos mayores.

name: Corvisquire
description_en: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
description_es: Corvisquire ha aprendido en duras batallas a evaluar con precisión la fuerza de sus oponentes.

name: Corviknight
description_en: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.
description_es: Corviknight es inteligente y vuela tan bien que se utiliza como taxi aéreo en Galar.

name: Blipbug
description_en: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
description_es: Blipbug vive en jardines y analiza el entorno mediante los pelos sensibles de su cuerpo.

name: Dottler
description_en: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
description_es: Dottler observa el exterior con poderes psíquicos mientras crece en su caparazón y prepara su evolución.

name: Orbeetle
description_en: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.
description_es: Orbeetle emplea su enorme poder psíquico para observar lugares situados a muchos kilómetros.

name: Nickit
description_en: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
description_es: Nickit roba comida con cautela y borra sus huellas usando la cola al escapar.

name: Thievul
description_en: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
description_es: Thievul utiliza sus garras y cuerpo ágil para robar comida y huevos; Boltund es su enemigo natural.

name: Gossifleur
description_en: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
description_es: Gossifleur gira al viento mientras canta alegremente y cautiva a muchas personas.

name: Eldegoss
description_en: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
description_es: El algodón de la cabeza de Eldegoss se utiliza para hilar una lana brillante típica de Galar.

name: Wooloo
description_en: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
description_es: Wooloo no puede moverse si su lana crece demasiado; sus fibras producen tejidos resistentes.

name: Dubwool
description_en: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
description_es: Dubwool utiliza sus majestuosos cuernos para impresionar a posibles parejas y no para combatir.

name: Chewtle
description_en: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
description_es: Chewtle golpea primero con su cuerno duro y aprovecha el desconcierto para morder sin soltar.

name: Drednaw
description_en: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
description_es: Drednaw extiende rápidamente el cuello y clava sus colmillos en enemigos alejados.

name: Yamper
description_en: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
description_es: Yamper ayuda a las personas por conseguir golosinas y produce chispas eléctricas mientras corre.

name: Boltund
description_en: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
description_es: Boltund impulsa las patas con electricidad y puede correr a gran velocidad.

name: Rolycoly
description_en: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
description_es: Rolycoly se desplaza rodando como una rueda y obtiene energía al quemar carbón.

name: Carkol
description_en: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es: Carkol rueda rápidamente sobre sus patas y exhala llamas a temperaturas muy altas.

name: Coalossal
description_en: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
description_es: Durante las batallas, la montaña de carbón de Coalossal se pone al rojo vivo y lanza chispas.

name: Applin
description_en: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
description_es: Applin vive dentro de una manzana desde que nace; su sabor influye en su evolución.

name: Flapple
description_en: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
description_es: Flapple vuela con alas de piel de manzana y escupe un ácido poderoso.

name: Appletun
description_en: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
description_es: El cuerpo de Appletun está cubierto de néctar dulce; antiguamente los niños comían su piel.

name: Silicobra
description_en: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
description_es: Silicobra expulsa arena por las fosas nasales para cegar al enemigo y esconderse bajo tierra.

name: Sandaconda
description_en: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
description_es: Sandaconda se enrolla de una forma especial para expulsar arena con mayor eficacia.

name: Cramorant
description_en: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
description_es: Cramorant se traga Arrokuda enteros, aunque a veces confunde sus presas con otros Pokémon.

name: Arrokuda
description_en: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.
description_es: Arrokuda se vuelve muy lento después de comer, momento en que Cramorant puede tragárselo.

name: Barraskewda
description_en: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
description_es: Barraskewda gira las aletas de la cola para impulsarse a gran velocidad y atravesar presas.

name: Toxel
description_en: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
description_es: Toxel modifica sus sustancias venenosas para producir electricidad que puede provocar una ligera parálisis.

name: Toxtricity
description_en: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
description_es: Toxtricity tiene mal carácter y bebe agua estancada para absorber las toxinas que contiene.

name: Sizzlipede
description_en: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
description_es: Sizzlipede envuelve presas con su cuerpo caliente, las cocina y luego las devora.

name: Centiskorch
description_en: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
description_es: Centiskorch es extremadamente agresivo y combate con un cuerpo ardiente y colmillos afilados.

name: Clobbopus
description_en: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.
description_es: Los tentáculos de Clobbopus se regeneran cuando se desprenden; su inteligencia es muy limitada.

name: Grapploct
description_en: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
description_es: Grapploct sale del mar buscando rivales para poner a prueba sus habilidades y luego regresa.

name: Sinistea
description_en: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
description_es: Sinistea habita una taza de té antigua, aunque existen muchas imitaciones de esas piezas.

name: Polteageist
description_en: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
description_es: Polteageist puede aparecer en el té olvidado y transformarlo en otro ejemplar de su especie.

name: Hatenna
description_en: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
description_es: Hatenna huye al detectar emociones fuertes y prefiere lugares tranquilos sin personas.

name: Hattrem
description_en: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
description_es: Hattrem golpea a rivales ruidosos con sus trenzas, tan fuertes que noquearían a un boxeador.

name: Hatterene
description_en: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
description_es: Hatterene es conocida como la Bruja del Bosque y castiga violentamente los ruidos excesivos.

name: Impidimp
description_en: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
description_es: Impidimp entra furtivamente en casas, roba cosas y se alimenta de las emociones negativas.

name: Morgrem
description_en: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
description_es: Morgrem engaña a las personas para atraerlas al bosque; algunos creen que hace crecer cultivos.

name: Grimmsnarl
description_en: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
description_es: El pelo de Grimmsnarl funciona como músculos y atrapa enemigos como si fueran tentáculos.

name: Obstagoon
description_en: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
description_es: Obstagoon evolucionó tras numerosas peleas y su grito intimida incluso a adversarios fuertes.

name: Perrserker
description_en: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
description_es: Perrserker desarrolló garras que, al extenderse, se unen formando dagas peligrosas.

name: Cursola
description_en: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
description_es: El cuerpo ectoplásmico de Cursola puede dejar petrificado a quien se atreva a tocarlo.

name: Sirfetch'd
description_en: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
description_es: Sirfetch'd se defiende con un escudo de hojas y ataca con un puerro afilado.

name: Mr. Rime
description_en: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
description_es: Mr. Rime es popular por sus movimientos cómicos y libera energía psíquica desde el vientre.

name: Runerigus
description_en: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
description_es: Tocar el cuerpo sombrío de Runerigus provoca visiones de recuerdos terribles.

name: Milcery
description_en: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
description_es: Se dice que las pastelerías visitadas por Milcery tendrán suerte y prosperidad.

name: Alcremie
description_en: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
description_es: Cuando Alcremie está contento, la crema que produce se vuelve más dulce y rica.

name: Falinks
description_en: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
description_es: Falinks está formado por seis integrantes que combaten coordinados y cambian de formación.

name: Pincurchin
description_en: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.
description_es: Pincurchin almacena electricidad en sus púas, que continúan emitiéndola incluso cuando se desprenden.

name: Snom
description_en: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
description_es: Snom come nieve y, cuanto más consume, más grandes crecen las púas de su espalda.

name: Frosmoth
description_en: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
description_es: Frosmoth genera ventiscas con sus alas heladas para expulsar a quienes dañan campos y montañas.

name: Stonjourner
description_en: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
description_es: Stonjourner se reúne con otros de su especie formando círculos en una fecha específica del año.

name: Eiscue
description_en: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
description_es: Eiscue mantiene fría su cabeza con hielo y pesca utilizando su único pelo como señuelo.

name: Indeedee
description_en: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
description_es: Indeedee percibe emociones con los cuernos y obtiene fuerza de los sentimientos positivos.

name: Morpeko
description_en: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
description_es: Morpeko guarda semillas tostadas con electricidad, pero vuelve a sentir hambre poco después de comer.

name: Cufant
description_en: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
description_es: Cufant destaca por su fuerza y su cuerpo de cobre se vuelve verde bajo la lluvia.

name: Copperajah
description_en: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
description_es: Copperajah vive en manadas y puede pulverizar enormes rocas con la fuerza de su trompa.

name: Dracozolt
description_en: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
description_es: Dracozolt produce electricidad con la cola y tiene una parte superior desproporcionadamente pequeña.

name: Arctozolt
description_en: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
description_es: Arctozolt conservaba alimentos con el hielo de su cuerpo, pero se extinguió por su lentitud.

name: Dracovish
description_en: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
description_es: Dracovish tiene piernas veloces, aunque solo puede respirar cuando está bajo el agua.

name: Arctovish
description_en: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
description_es: Arctovish tiene un rostro resistente, pero sus dificultades respiratorias contribuyeron a su extinción.

name: Duraludon
description_en: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
description_es: Duraludon tiene un cuerpo metálico ligero y ágil y se refugia en cuevas para evitar la lluvia.

name: Dreepy
description_en: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
description_es: Dreepy es débil cuando está solo, pero mejora rápidamente al entrenar con sus compañeros.

name: Drakloak
description_en: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
description_es: Drakloak necesita cuidar a un Dreepy sobre su cabeza y se angustia cuando le falta.

name: Dragapult
description_en: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
description_es: Los Dreepy alojados en los cuernos de Dragapult esperan emocionados ser lanzados a gran velocidad.

name: Zacian
description_en: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
description_es: Zacian durmió durante años; algunas leyendas lo presentan como hermana o rival de Zamazenta.

name: Zamazenta
description_en: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
description_es: Zamazenta durmió durante siglos convertido en estatua y la gente llegó a olvidar su existencia.

name: Eternatus
description_en: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
description_es: Eternatus llegó dentro de un meteorito antiguo y parece relacionado con el fenómeno Dinamax.

name: Kubfu
description_en: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
description_es: Tirar del pelo blanco de Kubfu enciende su espíritu de lucha y aumenta su poder.

name: Urshifu
description_en: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
description_es: Urshifu entrena sus piernas corriendo por acantilados escarpados en montañas de una región lejana.

name: Zarude
description_en: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
description_es: Las lianas desprendidas de Zarude nutren el suelo y ayudan a crecer a las plantas del bosque.

name: Regieleki
description_en: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.
description_es: Regieleki está formado por un único órgano eléctrico capaz de generar energía para todo Galar.

name: Regidrago
description_en: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
description_es: Regidrago está formado por energía de dragón cristalizada y reúne el poder de muchos dragones.

name: Glastrier
description_en: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
description_es: Glastrier posee una fuerza colosal y su máscara de hielo es mucho más dura que el diamante.

name: Spectrier
description_en: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
description_es: Spectrier absorbe la fuerza vital de seres dormidos mientras galopa por la noche y busca soledad.

name: Calyrex
description_en: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
description_es: Calyrex fue un rey legendario de Galar y puede sanar corazones y hacer crecer plantas.
